verses.wbw: iti — так; uktāḥ — сказанные; te — те; mahā-ātmānaḥ — великие души; purī — Пури; prabhṛtayaḥ — и прочие; tadā — тогда; prayayuḥ — ушли; tatra — там; gaurāṅgaḥ — Гауранга; viśaśrāma — отдыхал; atha — же; kenacit — с кем-то.

verses.text: Услышав: «Идёт Океан милости», — Владыка слонов по приказу сделал все переправы ухоженными руками [людей].
verses.orig:
आयाति करुणासिन्धुरिति श्रुत्वा गजेश्वरः ।
आज्ञया सकलं तीर्थं चकार करलालितम् ॥६५॥
(निरोष्ठ्यः)
verses.translit:
āyāti karuṇā-sindhur iti śrutvā gajeśvaraḥ |
ājñayā sakalaṁ tīrthaṁ cakāra kara-lālitam ||65||
(niroṣṭhyaḥ)
verses.wbw: āyāti — приходит; karuṇā — милости; sindhuḥ — океан; iti — так; śrutvā — услышав; gaja-īśvaraḥ — владыка слонов (Гаджапати); ājñayā — по приказу; sakalam — все; tīrtham — переправы; cakāra — сделал; kara — руками; lālitam — ухоженными.
notes: Нирошт̣хья — стих без губных звуков (p, ph, b, bh, m, u, o, v). Хинди: «v в śrutvā и gajeśvara — полугласная, поэтому считается зубной». Гаджапати — титул царей Ориссы (Пратапарудра). Ср. ЧЧ Мадхья 16.112–116: царь велит готовить для Господа дома и новые лодки у переправ и ставить памятные столбы.

verses.text: Гопинатха, [украшенный] украшениями по всему телу, исполненный сладости, мощи и ясности, блистал, как игра речи поэта.
verses.orig:
सर्वाङ्गीनैरलङ्कारैर्माधुर्य्यौजःप्रसादवान् ।
गोपीनाथो रराजासौ वाग्विलासः कवेरिव ॥६६॥
verses.translit:
sarvāṅgīnair alaṅkārair mādhuryaujaḥ-prasādavān |
gopīnātho rarājāsau vāg-vilāsaḥ kaver iva ||66||
verses.wbw: sarva-aṅgīnaiḥ — по всему телу; alaṅkāraiḥ — украшениями; mādhurya — сладостью; ojaḥ — мощью; prasāda — ясностью; vān — обладающий; gopīnāthaḥ — Гопинатха; rarāja — блистал; asau — он; vāk — речи; vilāsaḥ — игра; kaveḥ — поэта; iva — как.
notes: Двойная игра: alaṅkāra — «украшения» и «поэтические фигуры»; mādhurya, ojas, prasāda — три достоинства (guṇa) поэтической речи. Санскритский комментарий в хинди-переводе издания поясняет: мадхурья — радость, растапливающая сердце; оджас — блеск, расширяющий сердце (в героической, отвратительной и яростной расах); прасада — то, что мгновенно охватывает сердце, как огонь сухое дерево.

verses.text: Обретя юное, непрестанно обновляющееся томление, прелестный царь блистал, как весна, соединённая с красой.
verses.orig:
उत्कण्ठां तरुणीं प्राप्य निरन्तरनवां नवाम् ।
रराज राजा मधुरः सश्रीक इव चैत्रिकः ॥६७॥
verses.translit:
utkaṇṭhāṁ taruṇīṁ prāpya nirantara-navāṁ navām |
rarāja rājā madhuraḥ saśrīka iva caitrikaḥ ||67||
verses.wbw: utkaṇṭhām — томление; taruṇīm — юное; prāpya — обретя; nirantara — непрестанно; navām navām — новое и новое; rarāja — блистал; rājā — царь; madhuraḥ — прелестный; sa-śrīkaḥ — с Шри (красой); iva — как; caitrikaḥ — весна (месяц Чайтра).
notes: Двойной смысл: taruṇī — «юная [девушка]»; madhura — также «весенний» (madhu = весна). Царь — Пратапарудра (хинди).

verses.text: Затем эти великие души, радостные, с лицами, сияющими довольством, вошли в храм великого Владыки Гопинатхи.
verses.orig:
तत एते महात्मानो गोपीनाथमहाप्रभोः ।
प्रासादं विविशुर्हृष्टाः प्रसादोल्लसिताननाः ॥६८॥
verses.translit:
tata ete mahātmāno gopīnātha-mahāprabhoḥ |
prāsādaṁ viviśur hṛṣṭāḥ prasādollasitānanāḥ ||68||
verses.wbw: tataḥ — затем; ete — эти; mahā-ātmānaḥ — великие души; gopīnātha — Гопинатхи; mahāprabhoḥ — великого Владыки; prāsādam — в храм; viviśuḥ — вошли; hṛṣṭāḥ — радостные; prasāda — довольством; ullasita — сияющими; ānanāḥ — [с] лицами.
notes: Игра prāsāda / prasāda.

verses.text: Там [привратники], помахивая тростями в руках, с великой радостью ввели их, забывших все иные желания, во внутренние покои.
verses.orig:
तत्र तान् परया प्रीत्या वेत्रवेल्लितपाणयः ।
अनयन्नन्तरं वेश्म विस्मृतान्यमनोरथान् ॥६९॥
verses.translit:
tatra tān parayā prītyā vetra-vellita-pāṇayaḥ |
anayann antaraṁ veśma vismṛtānya-manorathān ||69||
verses.wbw: tatra — там; tān — их; parayā — с великой; prītyā — радостью; vetra — тростями; vellita — помахивающие; pāṇayaḥ — [с] руками; anayan — ввели; antaram — во внутренние; veśma — покои; vismṛta — забывших; anya — иные; manorathān — желания.

verses.text: С любовью увидев Его, они достигли величайшей радости. Затем некий тамошний брахман, придя, пригласил Парамананду Пури на угощение.
verses.orig:
ते विलोक्याथ तं प्रेम्णा प्रीतिमापुर्महत्तराम् ।
अथ कश्चित् समागत्य तत्रत्यः पृथिवीसुरः ।
भिक्षार्थमवृणोत्तत्र परमानन्दपूरिणम् ॥७०॥
verses.translit:
te vilokyātha taṁ premṇā prītim āpur mahattarām |
atha kaścit samāgatya tatratyaḥ pṛthivī-suraḥ |
bhikṣārtham avṛṇot tatra paramānanda-pūriṇam ||70||
verses.wbw: te — они; vilokya — увидев; atha — затем; tam — его; premṇā — с любовью; prītim — радости; āpuḥ — достигли; mahattarām — величайшей; atha — затем; kaścit — некий; samāgatya — придя; tatratyaḥ — тамошний; pṛthivī-suraḥ — брахман; bhikṣā-artham — для угощения; avṛṇot — пригласил; tatra — там; paramānanda-pūriṇam — Парамананду Пури.
notes:
Стих из трёх строк (шесть пад) — видимо, полустишие соседнего стиха слилось при наборе ⟨?⟩. Текст так же в издании Госвами (GGM). Бхану Свами: стих у него тоже из шести пад, под тем же номером; нумерация совпадает.
---

verses.text: Тем временем пришёл Гаурачандра — сияющий, как миллион лун, подобный пылающей золотой горе, — словно восход удачи.
verses.orig:
अत्रान्तरे गौरचन्द्रश्चन्द्रकोटिसमुज्ज्वलः ।
ज्वलत्काञ्चनशैलाभो लाभोदय इवागमत् ॥७१॥
verses.translit:
atrāntare gauracandraś candra-koṭi-samujjvalaḥ |
jvalat-kāñcana-śailābho lābhodaya ivāgamat ||71||
verses.wbw: atra antare — тем временем; gauracandraḥ — Гаурачандра; candra — лун; koṭi — миллионами; samujjvalaḥ — сияющий; jvalat — пылающей; kāñcana — золотой; śaila — горе; ābhaḥ — подобный; lābha — удачи; udayaḥ — восход; iva — словно; āgamat — пришёл.
notes: Цепочка повторов на стыке (-candraś candra-, -ujjvalaḥ jvalat-, -ābho lābho-).

verses.text: Долго созерцая прелестного Гопинатху, словно воплощённое желание, Океан милости там исполнился радости.
verses.orig:
दृष्ट्वा चिरं कृपासिन्धुर्गोपीनाथं मनोरमम् ।
मनोरथं मूर्त्तिमन्तमिव तत्र मुदं ययौ ॥७२॥
verses.translit:
dṛṣṭvā ciraṁ kṛpā-sindhur gopīnāthaṁ manoramam |
manorathaṁ mūrttimantam iva tatra mudaṁ yayau ||72||
verses.wbw: dṛṣṭvā — созерцая; ciram — долго; kṛpā — милости; sindhuḥ — океан; gopīnātham — Гопинатху; manoramam — прелестного; manoratham — желание; mūrttimantam — воплощённое; iva — словно; tatra — там; mudam — радости; yayau — достиг.

verses.text: Затем брахман по имени Свапнешвара пригласил Его там на угощение и привёл к себе в дом.
verses.orig:
अथ स्वप्नेश्वरो नाम सोऽयं धरणिदैवतम् ।
भिक्षार्थमवृणोत्तत्र गृहेऽपि च समानयत् ॥७३॥
verses.translit:
atha svapneśvaro nāma so 'yaṁ dharaṇi-daivatam |
bhikṣārtham avṛṇot tatra gṛhe 'pi ca samānayat ||73||
verses.wbw: atha — затем; svapneśvaraḥ nāma — по имени Свапнешвара; saḥ ayam — этот; dharaṇi — земли; daivatam — бог (брахман); bhikṣā-artham — для угощения; avṛṇot — пригласил; tatra — там; gṛhe — в дом; api ca — и; samānayat — привёл.
notes: Свапнешвара — видимо, тот же брахман, что в ст. 70; в ЧЧ (Мадхья 16.100) брахман Свапнешвара зовёт Господа на обед в Катаке, а затем Господь отдыхает под деревом бакула (16.102).

verses.text: А других, во главе с Джагаданандой, преданных блаженству, Шри Рамананда Рай повёл к себе в дом.
verses.orig:
अन्यांस्तु जगदानन्दमुख्यान् सुखपरायणान् ।
श्रीरामानन्दरायोऽसौ निनाय निजमन्दिरम् ॥७४॥
verses.translit:
anyāṁs tu jagadānanda-mukhyān sukha-parāyaṇān |
śrī-rāmānanda-rāyo 'sau nināya nija-mandiram ||74||
verses.wbw: anyān tu — других же; jagadānanda-mukhyān — во главе с Джагаданандой; sukha — блаженству; parāyaṇān — преданных; śrī-rāmānanda-rāyaḥ — Шри Рамананда Рай; asau — этот; nināya — повёл; nija — в свой; mandiram — дом.

verses.text:
Пословно (по комментарию издания). Первая строка: āgāra — дому; ā-hitya — вполне благотворном; sukha-de — дающем радость; manorāme — прелестном. Вторая строка: āga (= aga «гора») — гор; arāhitya — [радость] неотъемлемую, т. е. pārvatya-sukha «радость горной местности»; sukha-de — дающем; sadā-ārāme — в прекрасном саду; tadā — тогда; ānayat — привёл; saḥ — он; tān — их; atha — затем.
Затем он привёл их в сад — прелестный, благотворный для дома и дающий радость, — в прекрасный сад, дающий радость горной местности.
verses.orig:
आगाराहित्यसुखदे मनोरामे स तानथ ।
आगाराहित्यसुखदे सदारामे तदानयत् ॥७५॥
verses.translit:
āgārāhitya-sukhade manorāme sa tān atha |
āgārāhitya-sukhade sadārāme tadānayat ||75||
notes: Ямака: строки почти совпадают по звучанию (āgārāhitya-sukhade). Разбор комментария: hitaṁ karotīti hityam (с суффиксом yat); na gacchantīti agāḥ — «неподвижные», т. е. горы, с суффиксом aṇ — āgāḥ; sadārāma — превосходный сад близ дома. Перевод условен ⟨?⟩. Текст так же в издании Госвами (GGM). Бхану Свами: понимает иначе: сад, приносящий пользу дому, радость и счастье; прекрасный сад у дома, дающий радость леса. ---

verses.text: Доставив им отраду сада, Рамананда, творящий ликование радости людей, поспешно отправился к царю.
verses.orig:
आरामारामललितान् कृत्वा तानथ सत्वरम् ।
रामानन्दो जनानन्दोल्लासकृद्भूपमासदत् ॥७६॥
verses.translit:
ārāmārāma-lalitān kṛtvā tān atha satvaram |
rāmānando janānandollāsa-kṛd bhūpam āsadat ||76||
verses.wbw: ārāma — сада; ārāma — отрадой; lalitān — довольными; kṛtvā — сделав; tān — их; atha — затем; satvaram — поспешно; rāmānandaḥ — Рамананда; jana — людей; ānanda — радости; ullāsa — ликование; kṛt — творящий; bhūpam — к царю; āsadat — отправился.

verses.text: Отдохнув, они там занялись стряпнёй, а свами Пури, совершив трапезу, пришёл туда вместе с Господом.
verses.orig:
ते तत्र रन्धनोद्योगं चक्रुर्विश्रमणान्तरम् ।
कृतभिक्षः पुरीस्वामी प्रभुना तत्र चागमत् ॥७७॥
verses.translit:
te tatra randhanodyogaṁ cakrur viśramaṇāntaram |
kṛta-bhikṣaḥ purī-svāmī prabhuṇā tatra cāgamat ||77||
verses.wbw: te — они; tatra — там; randhana — к стряпне; udyogam — приготовления; cakruḥ — сделали; viśramaṇa — отдыха; antaram — после; kṛta — совершивший; bhikṣaḥ — трапезу; purī-svāmī — свами Пури; prabhuṇā — с Господом; tatra — туда; ca — и; āgamat — пришёл.
notes: В издании randhona- — опечатка; хинди: «стряпня».

verses.text: Там, посреди сада, есть высокое дерево бакула — раскидистое, с густой тенью, среди своего рода — [богатое, как Кубера].
verses.orig:
तत्रोपवनमध्येऽस्ति सूच्छ्रितो वकुलद्रुमः ।
विसारी निबिडच्छायः कुलानां वकुलद्रुमः ॥७८॥
verses.translit:
tatropavana-madhye 'sti sūcchrito vakula-drumaḥ |
visārī nibiḍa-cchāyaḥ kulānāṁ vakula-drumaḥ (? bakula = ba-kula / kubera) ||78||
verses.wbw: tatra — там; upavana — сада; madhye — посреди; asti — есть; su-ucchritaḥ — высокое; vakula-drumaḥ — дерево бакула; visārī — раскидистое; nibiḍa — густой; chāyaḥ — [с] тенью; kulānām — среди родов [деревьев]; va-kula-drumaḥ (?) — [как] Кубера.
notes: Вторая пада обыгрывает первую (ямака), но смысл неясен ⟨?⟩. Хинди: «среди деревьев своего рода это дерево бакула было богато, как Кубера, т. е. подобно древу желаний»; видимо, вторая vakula-druma разбирается иначе. Текст так же в издании Госвами (GGM). Бхану Свами: «оно было лучшим среди деревьев бакула» — вторая vakula-druma понята как «лучшее в роду»; близко к хинди («богатое, как Кубера, среди своего рода»). ---

verses.text: Полоса леса, прелестная превосходной мерой [деревьев] — [или: овеваемая] со всех сторон [ветром], — стала тогда [прудом] с живыми лотосами.
verses.orig:
परमानेन ललिता परमानेन सर्वतः ।
राजीवनस्य साजीवराजीवयुगथाभवत् ॥७९॥
verses.translit:
paramānena lalitā paramānena (pavamānena?) sarvataḥ |
rājī vanasya sājīva-rājīva-yug athābhavat ||79||
verses.wbw: para-mānena — превосходной мерой; lalitā — прелестная; pavamānena (вар.) — ветром; sarvataḥ — со всех сторон; rājī — полоса [деревьев]; vanasya — леса; sa-jīva — живыми; rājīva — лотосами; yuk — снабжённая; atha — тогда; abhavat — стала.
notes: Издание указывает разночтение: вместо paramānena lalitā paramānena sarvataḥ — pavamānena lalitā pavamānena sarvataḥ «пленительная от ветра, тихо веющего отовсюду». Хинди к rājīva: «лес с живыми лотосами». Смысл неясен ⟨?⟩. Текст так же в издании Госвами (GGM). Бхану Свами: «дерево было огромным, больше всех других, окружённое лотосами, дающими лесу жизнь» — paramānena понято как «величиной». ---

verses_en.text: And Ramananda, a great treasure-house [of love] — how will he [live] in sorrow at not seeing this object of his love?
notes: A variant reading given in the edition: kariṣyati, "how will he act".

verses_en.text: Then an abundance of mahaprasada of four kinds, sent by Vaninatha, at once arrived there in great quantity.
verses_en.orig:
ततो महाप्रसादौघः सद्यस्तत्र चतुर्विधः ।
वाणीनाथेन प्रहितो मिलितोऽभूदनेकशः ॥३५॥
verses_en.translit:
tato mahāprasādaughaḥ sadyas tatra catur-vidhaḥ |
vāṇīnāthena prahito milito 'bhūd anekaśaḥ ||35||
verses_en.wbw: tataḥ — then; mahā-prasāda — of mahaprasada; oghaḥ — an abundance; sadyaḥ — at once; tatra — there; catuḥ-vidhaḥ — of four kinds; vāṇīnāthena — by Vaninatha; prahitaḥ — sent; militaḥ abhūt — arrived; anekaśaḥ — in great quantity.
notes: The four kinds of food are those that are chewed, swallowed, licked and drunk. Vaninatha (Pattanayaka) is the brother of Ramananda Raya.

verses_en.text: Seeing the splendid, unsurpassed mahaprasada that had just arrived from Nilachala, the supreme Lord rejoiced.
verses_en.orig:
नीलाचलात् समायान्तं सद्यः श्रीमदनूत्तमम् ।
महाप्रसादं दृष्ट्वासौ मुमुदे परमप्रभुः ॥३६॥
verses_en.translit:
nīlācalāt samāyāntaṁ sadyaḥ śrīmad-anūttamam |
mahāprasādaṁ dṛṣṭvāsau mumude parama-prabhuḥ ||36||
verses_en.wbw: nīlācalāt — from Nilachala; samāyāntam — arriving; sadyaḥ — just now; śrīmat — splendid; anūttamam — unsurpassed; mahā-prasādam — the mahaprasada; dṛṣṭvā — having seen; asau — He; mumude — rejoiced; parama-prabhuḥ — the supreme Lord.

verses_en.text:
Word for word (following the commentary): nanu — oh!; nānānā — a certain man among many; nuni — humbly (?); ā-aṇūn — quite small [offerings]; nānā — manifold; ina — to the Lord; inān — equal (= the Lord's prasada); anaṇūn anu — considering [them] abundant; nānā-anūne — in regard to variety and abundance; ānana — of the mouth; anna — of the food (= the nectar of the lips); ūne — in a [supposed] deficiency; no — not; nānā — "[it is] little"; nut — saying; na — was not.
Oh! A certain man among many, seeing the manifold [gifts of prasada], equal to the Lord, considered them abundant, though they were quite small: neither as to their variety and quantity, nor on the ground that they fell short of the nectar of His lips, did he say, "[It is] little."
verses_en.orig:
नानाना नुनि नानेने नाना नूननू ननु ।
नाना नूने नाननान्नोने नो नान ननुन्ननु ॥३७॥
(पुनरेकाक्षरः)
verses_en.translit:
nānānā nuni nānene nānā nūnanū nanu |
nānā nūne nānanānnone no nāna nanunnanu ||37||
(punar ekākṣaraḥ)
The edition's word division and prose order: nanu nānānā nuni ā-aṇūn nānā-inenān anaṇūn anu | nānānūne na ānana-anna-ūne no nānā nut na nanu.
notes: Again an ekākṣara: the whole verse uses only the consonant n (ṇ being treated as equal to n). The sense follows the edition's Sanskrit commentary: the Lord's prasada is equal to the Lord Himself, and so even a small quantity of it was honoured by all as abundant. The commentary quotes the Brihad-bhagavatamrita: "What is offered to the Lord of the world — food, drink and the rest — is unchanging like Brahman: as Vishnu is, so is it." Ina — "lord, master"; inena tulyaḥ inaḥ — "[the prasada,] equal to the Lord". The translation is tentative ⟨?⟩. Metre: the second pada (nānā nūnanū nanu) has only seven syllables ⟨?⟩. The Gosvami edition (GGM) has the same text.

verses_en.text: Having partaken of the mahaprasada there and rested for a moment, the Treasure-house of Mercy joyfully set out again together with them.
verses_en.orig:
महाप्रसादोपयोगं कृत्वा तत्र कृपानिधिः ।
विश्रम्य च क्षणं हर्षात् प्रतस्थे तैः समं पुनः ॥३८॥
verses_en.translit:
mahāprasādopayogaṁ kṛtvā tatra kṛpā-nidhiḥ |
viśramya ca kṣaṇaṁ harṣāt pratasthe taiḥ samaṁ punaḥ ||38||
verses_en.wbw: mahā-prasāda — of the mahaprasada; upayogam — partaking; kṛtvā — having done; tatra — there; kṛpā-nidhiḥ — the Treasure-house of Mercy; viśramya — having rested; ca — and; kṣaṇam — for a moment; harṣāt — joyfully; pratasthe — set out; taiḥ samam — with them; punaḥ — again.

verses_en.text: Whenever He reached some place and stopped there, everyone came from all around, eager to see Him — that was a wonder indeed!
verses_en.orig:
कञ्चिद्देशं समासाद्य स्थितं तं सर्व एव हि ।
द्रष्टुं समन्तादौत्सुक्यादाययौ चित्रमेव तत् ॥३९॥
verses_en.translit:
kañcid deśaṁ samāsādya sthitaṁ taṁ sarva eva hi |
draṣṭuṁ samantād autsukyād āyayau citram eva tat ||39||
verses_en.wbw: kañcit — some; deśam — place; samāsādya — having reached; sthitam — staying; tam — Him; sarvaḥ eva — everyone; hi — indeed; draṣṭum — to see; samantāt — from all around; autsukyāt — out of eagerness; āyayau — came; citram — a wonder; eva — indeed; tat — that.

verses_en.text: As soon as He stopped, the local people [living] all around were drawn, together with the wind, by the fragrances of His steadfastness and kindliness.
verses_en.orig:
विरमत्येव ये वास्मिन् कृष्टा आसन् समन्ततः ।
तत्रत्या वायुना सार्द्धं धैर्यसौहित्यसौरभैः ॥४०॥
verses_en.translit:
viramaty eva ye vāsmin kṛṣṭā āsan samantataḥ |
tatratyā vāyunā sārdhaṁ dhairya-sauhitya-saurabhaiḥ ||40||
verses_en.wbw: viramati — stopping; eva — just; ye — who; vā — indeed; asmin — [when] He; kṛṣṭāḥ — drawn; āsan — were; samantataḥ — from all around; tatratyāḥ — the local [people]; vāyunā sārdham — together with the wind; dhairya — of steadfastness; sauhitya — [and] kindliness; saurabhaiḥ — by the fragrances.

verses_en.text:
Word for word (following the edition's commentary): līlā — in play; lola — restless; ali — of the bees; lalanāḥ — the female companions; lalan — desiring; nalina — of the lotuses; lālanaiḥ — by the swaying; lalanā-ālīnām — of those clinging to [their] companions; līlām — the play; lān — taking; anilaḥ — the wind; lalan — desiring [= well pleased]; nalāla (?) — moved.
The wind, swaying the lotuses, desiring the female companions of the bees, restless in their play, and taking on the play proper to those who cling to their companions, moved along, well pleased ⟨?⟩.
verses_en.orig:
लीलालोलालिललना ललन्नलिनलालनैः ।
नलाल ललनालीनां लीलां लाननिलो ललन् ॥४१॥
(द्व्यक्षरः)
verses_en.translit:
līlā-lolāli-lalanā lalan nalina-lālanaiḥ |
nalāla (? calāla) lalanālīnāṁ līlāṁ lān anilo lalan ||41||
(dvyakṣaraḥ)
notes: A dvyakṣara: the verse uses only two consonants, l and n. The commentary: "anilaḥ — the wind; nalina-lālanaiḥ — by swaying the lotuses: as a husband beckons his playful wife with his hand, so the wind, desiring the bees' companions, moved, swaying the lotuses, [its] hands." The commentary explains the verb nalāla as cacāla, "moved", by the rule that ḍa and la are identical (from the root laḍ); the passage is obscure ⟨?⟩. The conjecture calāla recorded in the IAST line would break the two-consonant scheme. Metre: both lines are regular (the first pada is a na-vipulā). The Gosvami edition (GGM) has the same text.

verses_en.text: Going along the road together with those accomplished [companions], amid manifestations of love, He plunged into the supreme long pond of the nectar of bliss.
verses_en.orig:
पथि प्रेमाविष्कृतिभिः कृतिभिस्तैः समं व्रजन् ।
मज्जति स्मैष परमामानन्दामृतदीर्घिकाम् ॥४२॥
verses_en.translit:
pathi premāviṣkṛtibhiḥ kṛtibhis taiḥ samaṁ vrajan |
majjati smaiṣa paramām ānandāmṛta-dīrghikām ||42||
verses_en.wbw: pathi — on the road; prema — of love; āviṣkṛtibhiḥ — with manifestations; kṛtibhiḥ — accomplished; taiḥ — with those; samam — together; vrajan — going; majjati sma — plunged; eṣaḥ — He; paramām — into the supreme; ānanda — of bliss; amṛta — of the nectar; dīrghikām — long pond.
notes: A chime of sounds: premāviṣkṛtibhiḥ kṛtibhiḥ.

verses_en.text: Then, seeing a splendid tree, He ran to it from afar, unrestrained, leapt up, caught hold of a bough and, hanging from it, displayed [great] beauty.
verses_en.orig:
अथ वीक्ष्य द्रुमं श्रेष्ठं धावन्नारादवारितः ।
स्कन्धमुत्प्लुत्य धृत्वा च लम्बमानः श्रियं दधे ॥४३॥
verses_en.translit:
atha vīkṣya drumaṁ śreṣṭhaṁ dhāvann ārād avāritaḥ |
skandham utplutya dhṛtvā ca lambamānaḥ śriyaṁ dadhe ||43||
verses_en.wbw: atha — then; vīkṣya — having seen; drumam — a tree; śreṣṭham — splendid; dhāvan — running; ārāt — from afar; avāritaḥ — unrestrained; skandham — a bough; utplutya — having leapt up; dhṛtvā — having caught hold of; ca — and; lambamānaḥ — hanging; śriyam — beauty; dadhe — displayed.

verses_en.text: Bathed in the waters of His eyes, He embraced the tree again. Whom indeed, and by what means, did Mahaprabhu not deliver?
verses_en.orig:
आलिलिङ्ग तरुं भूयो लोचनाम्बुभिराप्लुतः ।
कं वा केन प्रकारेण नोद्दधार महाप्रभुः ॥४४॥
verses_en.translit:
ālilinga taruṁ bhūyo locanāmbubhir āplutaḥ |
kaṁ vā kena prakāreṇa noddadhāra mahāprabhuḥ ||44||
verses_en.wbw: ālilinga — embraced; tarum — the tree; bhūyaḥ — again; locana — of the eyes; ambubhiḥ — with the waters; āplutaḥ — bathed; kam — whom; vā — indeed; kena — by what; prakāreṇa — means; na uddadhāra — did not deliver; mahāprabhuḥ — Mahaprabhu.

verses_en.text: In the forest the peacock's cry — not alone, but [joined] by [the call of] the lāvaka bird, as if by a crow — fond of the pure showers, truly and at once giving praise, surpassed in praise [even] sweet intoxication ⟨?⟩.
verses_en.orig:
का के ने व व ने के का
ला व के न न के व ला ।
शु द्धा सा र र सा द्धा शु
नु ति र सु सु रा ति नु ॥४५॥
(प्रतिलोमानुलोमपादः)
verses_en.translit:
kā kene va vane kekā
lāvakena na kevalā |
śuddhāsāra-rasāddhāśu-
nuti-rā su-surātinu ||45||
(pratilomānuloma-pādaḥ)
The commentary's word division of the second half: śuddha-āsāra-rasā addhā āśu nuti-rā su-surā-atinu.
verses_en.wbw: kākena iva — as by a crow; vane — in the forest; kekā — the peacock's cry; lāvakena — by the lāvaka bird; na kevalā — not alone (= accompanied); śuddha — pure; āsāra — of the showers (of the rainy season); rasā — fond; addhā — truly; āśu — at once; nuti — praise; rā — giving; su-surā — sweet intoxication; atinu — surpassing in praise.
notes: A pratilomānuloma-pāda: each pada reads the same from left to right and from right to left (a palindrome): kā ke ne va va ne ke kā, and so on. The printed syllables kā kene va are taken as kākena iva. The translation follows the edition's Sanskrit commentary; the sense is tentative ⟨?⟩. The lāvaka is a kind of quail. The Gosvami edition (GGM) has the same text.

verses_en.text: Thus, overwhelmed, He embraces [these trees as] the trees of Vrindavana; and He embraced the tree so [hard] that it seemed again and again about to crumble to powder.
verses_en.orig:
वृन्दावनद्रुमानित्थमालिङ्गयति विह्वलः ।
तथालिलिङ्ग स तरुं यथा चूर्णायते मुहुः ॥४६॥
verses_en.translit:
vṛndāvana-drumān ittham āliṅgayati vihvalaḥ |
tathālilinga sa taruṁ yathā cūrṇāyate muhuḥ ||46||
verses_en.wbw: vṛndāvana — of Vrindavana; drumān — the trees; ittham — thus; āliṅgayati — embraces; vihvalaḥ — overwhelmed; tathā — so; ālilinga — embraced; saḥ — He; tarum — the tree; yathā — that; cūrṇāyate — is crumbling to powder; muhuḥ — again and again.

verses_en.text: When He was about to fall down onto [ground] strewn with thorns, [Paramananda] Puri and the others, in alarm, at once caught Him with their strong arms.
verses_en.orig:
अधः कण्टकसंकीर्णे निपतिष्यन्तमञ्जसा ।
भिया पुरिप्रभृतयो जगृहुर्वरबाहुभिः ॥४७॥
verses_en.translit:
adhaḥ kaṇṭaka-saṅkīrṇe nipatiṣyantam añjasā |
bhiyā puri-prabhṛtayo jagṛhur vara-bāhubhiḥ ||47||
verses_en.wbw: adhaḥ — down; kaṇṭaka — with thorns; saṅkīrṇe — onto [a place] strewn; nipatiṣyantam — about to fall; añjasā — at once; bhiyā — in alarm; puri — Puri; prabhṛtayaḥ — and the others; jagṛhuḥ — caught [Him]; vara — strong; bāhubhiḥ — with arms.

verses_en.text: Then He said: "Look, look! Here is Krishnachandra all around, sporting in every tree! The world is seen to consist of Him."
verses_en.orig:
ऊचेऽथ पश्य पश्यायं कृष्णचन्द्रोऽभितोऽभितः ।
प्रतिद्रुमं विलसति जगत्येतन्मयीक्ष्यते ॥४८॥
verses_en.translit:
ūce 'tha paśya paśyāyaṁ kṛṣṇacandro 'bhito 'bhitaḥ |
pratidrumaṁ vilasati jagaty etan mayīkṣyate ||48||
verses_en.wbw: ūce — said; atha — then; paśya paśya — look, look; ayam — here [is]; kṛṣṇacandraḥ — Krishnachandra; abhitaḥ abhitaḥ — everywhere around; pratidrumam — in every tree; vilasati — sports; jagatī — the world; etat-mayī — consisting of Him; īkṣyate — is seen.
notes: Jagaty etan mayīkṣyate is divided jagatī etan-mayī īkṣyate, "the world is seen as consisting of Him": mayā + īkṣyate would give mayekṣyate, so mayī must be the feminine of the suffix -maya, agreeing with jagatī. Paśyāyam = paśya ayam (regular sandhi).

verses_en.text: The water ⟨?⟩, exceedingly clear and boundless, shone constantly, and the surface of the earth [was] free of mud; and most wonderful then was the Lord's journey.
verses_en.orig:
अवपयोऽतिविमलमनन्तमसकृद्बभौ ।
निष्पङ्कं भूतलं चाथ चित्रचित्रा प्रभोर्गतिः ॥४९॥
(श्लोकावृत्तिः)
verses_en.translit:
avapayo 'tivimalam anantam asakṛd babhau |
niṣpaṅkaṁ bhūtalaṁ cātha citra-citrā prabhor gatiḥ ||49||
(ślokāvṛttiḥ)
verses_en.wbw: avapayaḥ (?) — the water (?); ati-vimalam — exceedingly clear; anantam — boundless; asakṛt — constantly; babhau — shone; niṣpaṅkam — free of mud; bhū-talam — the surface of the earth; ca — and; atha — then; citra-citrā — most wonderful; prabhoḥ — of the Lord; gatiḥ — the journey.
notes: The label ślokāvṛtti ("repetition of the verse") apparently means that the verse admits a second reading with a different word division ⟨?⟩; how it is meant is not explained. Avapayaḥ is unclear ⟨?⟩: the neuter adjectives ativimalam anantam seem to agree with payaḥ, "water", but ava- remains unexplained; the first line may also be referred to the sky or to the earth ⟨?⟩. Clear water and dry earth mark autumn, the season after the rains (cf. 4–5). Metre: the first pada is irregular — its second and third syllables (-va-pa-) are both light. The Gosvami edition (GGM) has the same text.

verses_en.text: Through the Lord's triumphal journey this autumn — rich in sap, sweetly smiling with the blossoming flowers of the kasha grass — then shone still more beautifully.
verses_en.orig:
अधिकं शुशुभे तत्र विजयेन प्रभोरसौ ।
विकसत्काशकुसुमसुस्मिता सुरसा शरत् ॥५०॥
verses_en.translit:
adhikaṁ śuśubhe tatra vijayena prabhor asau |
vikasat-kāśa-kusuma-susmitā surasā śarat ||50||
verses_en.wbw: adhikam — still more; śuśubhe — shone; tatra — then; vijayena — by the [triumphal] journey; prabhoḥ — of the Lord; asau — this; vikasat — blossoming; kāśa — of kasha grass; kusuma — with the flowers; su-smitā — sweetly smiling; su-rasā — rich in sap; śarat — autumn.
notes: Kasha grass (Saccharum spontaneum) bears white plumes in autumn; in poetics whiteness is a "smile".

verses_en.text: Arriving at Bhubaneshvara, He saw Bhuvaneshvara [Shiva], honoured the mahaprasada and stopped right there [for the night].
verses_en.orig:
भुवनेश्वर आगत्य ददर्श भुवनेश्वरम् ।
महाप्रसादं प्रोपास्य तत्रैव विरराम सः ॥५१॥
verses_en.translit:
bhuvaneśvara āgatya dadarśa bhuvaneśvaram |
mahāprasādaṁ propāsya tatraiva virarāma saḥ ||51||
verses_en.wbw: bhuvaneśvare — at Bhubaneshvara; āgatya — having arrived; dadarśa — saw; bhuvaneśvaram — Bhuvaneshvara (Shiva); mahā-prasādam — the mahaprasada; propāsya — having honoured; tatra eva — right there; virarāma — stopped; saḥ — He.
notes: Bhubaneshvara is both the town and its deity of the same name — Shiva as Lingaraja, the "Lord of the Worlds". Cf. Chaitanya-charitamrita, Madhya 16.98–99: Ramananda follows the Lord in a palanquin, Vaninatha sends prasada, and next morning the Lord comes to Bhubaneshvara.

verses_en.text: The next day, at the end of the night, the Lord set out with them; and meeting Haridasa ahead [of Him], Mahaprabhu entered a village.
verses_en.orig:
अन्येद्यू रजनीशेषे प्रतस्थे तैः समं प्रभुः ।
हरिदासं पुरः प्राप्याविशद्ग्रामं महाप्रभुः ॥५२॥
verses_en.translit:
anyedyū rajanī-śeṣe pratasthe taiḥ samaṁ prabhuḥ |
haridāsaṁ puraḥ prāpyāviśad grāmaṁ mahāprabhuḥ ||52||
verses_en.wbw: anyedyuḥ — on the next day; rajanī — of the night; śeṣe — at the end; pratasthe — set out; taiḥ samam — with them; prabhuḥ — the Lord; haridāsam — Haridasa; puraḥ — ahead; prāpya — having met; aviśat — entered; grāmam — a village; mahāprabhuḥ — Mahaprabhu.
notes: Which Haridasa and which village are meant is unclear; the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 16) does not mention this meeting. According to 54, Ramananda had prepared lodgings here in advance — apparently on his own land.

verses_en.text: That [autumn] — a fresh, ever-fresh earth, full of water and of sarasa cranes, bestowing the essence on all things embodied and unembodied, filled with juices — [shone] ⟨?⟩.
verses_en.orig:
सा र सा स र सा रं
र सा नू त न नू त ना ।
ना त नू त त नू सा र
रं सा सा र स सा र सा ॥५३॥
(प्रतिलोमानुलोमश्लोकः)
verses_en.translit:
sārasā sarasā (?) raṁ
rasā nūtana-nūtanā |
nātanūtatanū-sāra-
raṁsā sā rasa-sārasā ||53||
(pratilomānuloma-ślokaḥ)
verses_en.wbw: sārasā — full of sarasa cranes; sa-rasā — full of water; ram (?) — ⟨?⟩; rasā — the earth; nūtana-nūtanā — new and ever new; na-atanū-atanū — of [things] embodied and unembodied (?); sāra — the essence; raṁsā (?) — bestowing; sā — she (autumn); rasa — with juices; sārasā — filled.
notes: A pratilomānuloma-śloka: the whole verse, written out syllable by syllable, reads the same from the beginning and from the end. The word division is partly conjectural ⟨?⟩. As printed, the palindrome is imperfect: the first pada has only seven syllables (सा र सा स र सा रं), whereas the mirror image of the fourth (रं सा सा र स सा र सा) requires eight — सा र सा स र सा सा रं; and the fifth syllable of the second pada (na in nūtana) does not mirror the fourth syllable of the third (ta). Metre: apart from the short first pada, the verse is regular. The Gosvami edition (GGM) has the same text.

verses_en.text: Ramananda Raya, who beforehand had by his orders had a new house and other [buildings] put up there, at once led the Lord [to it].
verses_en.orig:
तत्र नूतनगेहादि कारयित्वा निदेशतः ।
पुरा रामानन्दरायो निनाय प्रभुमञ्जसा ॥५४॥
verses_en.translit:
tatra nūtana-gehādi kārayitvā nideśataḥ |
purā rāmānanda-rāyo nināya prabhum añjasā ||54||
verses_en.wbw: tatra — there; nūtana — a new; geha — house; ādi — and so on; kārayitvā — having had built; nideśataḥ — by [his] orders; purā — beforehand; rāmānanda-rāyaḥ — Ramananda Raya; nināya — led; prabhum — the Lord; añjasā — at once.

verses_en.text: Seeing the clean, freshly plastered house there, the Treasure-house of Mercy stayed in it with the greatest delight, together with Paramananda Puri.
verses_en.orig:
लेपितं शुद्धमालोक्य गृहं तत्र कृपानिधिः ।
उवास परमप्रीत्या परमानन्दपूरिणा ॥५५॥
verses_en.translit:
lepitaṁ śuddham ālokya gṛhaṁ tatra kṛpā-nidhiḥ |
uvāsa parama-prītyā paramānanda-pūriṇā ||55||
verses_en.wbw: lepitam — plastered; śuddham — clean; ālokya — having seen; gṛham — the house; tatra — there; kṛpā-nidhiḥ — the Treasure-house of Mercy; uvāsa — stayed; parama — with the greatest; prītyā — delight; paramānanda-pūriṇā — with Paramananda Puri.
notes: Lepita — [walls and floor] plastered with clay and cow dung, a purification of a dwelling. A possible play: paramānanda-pūriṇā also suggests "filled with supreme bliss".

verses_en.text: Then from Nilachala an abundance of mahaprasada — fine rice, drinks and cakes — arrived swiftly, again and again.
verses_en.orig:
ततो नीलाचलादाशु समायातोऽभवन्मुहुः ।
महाप्रसादनिचयः स्वन्नपानकपिष्टकः ॥५६॥
verses_en.translit:
tato nīlācalād āśu samāyāto 'bhavan muhuḥ |
mahāprasāda-nicayaḥ sv-anna-pānaka-piṣṭakaḥ ||56||
verses_en.wbw: tataḥ — then; nīlācalāt — from Nilachala; āśu — swiftly; samāyātaḥ abhavat — arrived; muhuḥ — again and again; mahā-prasāda — of mahaprasada; nicayaḥ — an abundance; su-anna — [with] fine rice; pānaka — drinks; piṣṭakaḥ — [and] cakes.
notes: The first syllables of the second half are damaged in the printed text; the reading given is a reconstruction ⟨?⟩. Piṣṭaka — rice cakes (Bengali pitha).

verses_en.text: He whose command Brahma, Rudra and the others praise, placing it on their heads — can His majesty be known by people? By whom indeed [is His] majesty [known]?
verses_en.orig:
यदाज्ञा ब्रह्मरुद्राद्यैराधाय शिरसीड्यते ।
किं तस्य विभवो लोकैर्ज्ञायते विभवो नु कैः ॥५७॥
verses_en.translit:
yad-ājñā brahma-rudrādyair ādhāya śirasīḍyate |
kiṁ tasya vibhavo lokair jñāyate vibhavo nu kaiḥ ||57||
verses_en.wbw: yat — whose; ājñā — command; brahma — by Brahma; rudra — Rudra; ādyaiḥ — and the others; ādhāya — having placed; śirasi — on the head; īḍyate — is praised; kim — whether; tasya — His; vibhavaḥ — majesty; lokaiḥ — by people; jñāyate — is known; vibhavaḥ — majesty; nu — indeed; kaiḥ — by whom.

verses_en.text: Seeing it, He was supremely pleased; He honoured it with love together with them, and spent the night in conversation with Sri Ramananda Raya.
verses_en.orig:
तं दृष्ट्वा परमप्रीतः प्रेम्णोपास्य च तैः समम् ।
श्रीरामानन्दरायेण कथया रजनीं ययौ ॥५८॥
verses_en.translit:
taṁ dṛṣṭvā parama-prītaḥ premṇopāsya ca taiḥ samam |
śrī-rāmānanda-rāyeṇa kathayā rajanīṁ yayau ||58||
verses_en.wbw: tam — it (the prasada); dṛṣṭvā — having seen; parama — supremely; prītaḥ — pleased; premṇā — with love; upāsya — having honoured; ca — and; taiḥ samam — together with them; śrī-rāmānanda-rāyeṇa — with Sri Ramananda Raya; kathayā — in conversation; rajanīm — the night; yayau — spent.

verses_en.text: Wholly given to telling various stories together with him, the Lord, beautiful as the lord of the night, passed the night.
verses_en.orig:
एतेनैव समं नानाकथाकथनतत्परः ।
निनाय रजनीं नाथो रजनीनाथसुन्दरः ॥५९॥
verses_en.translit:
etenaiva samaṁ nānā-kathā-kathana-tat-paraḥ |
nināya rajanīṁ nātho rajanī-nātha-sundaraḥ ||59||
verses_en.wbw: etena eva samam — together with him; nānā — of various; kathā — stories; kathana — to the telling; tat-paraḥ — wholly given; nināya — passed; rajanīm — the night; nāthaḥ — the Lord; rajanī-nātha — [as] the lord of the night (the moon); sundaraḥ — beautiful.
notes: A play on words: rajanīṁ nātho rajanī-nātha-, "the night … the Lord … the lord of the night".

verses_en.text: The Lord and Paramananda Puri too went on ahead, while the wise Ramananda followed along behind [them].
verses_en.orig:
प्रभुश्च परमानन्दपुरी चापि पुरो ययौ ।
रामानन्दस्तु मतिमान् पश्चात् पश्चात् समाययौ ॥६०॥
verses_en.translit:
prabhuś ca paramānanda-purī cāpi puro yayau |
rāmānandas tu matimān paścāt paścāt samāyayau ||60||
verses_en.wbw: prabhuḥ — the Lord; ca — and; paramānanda-purī — Paramananda Puri; ca api — also; puraḥ — ahead; yayau — went; rāmānandaḥ tu — but Ramananda; matimān — wise; paścāt paścāt — behind, behind; samāyayau — followed.

verses_en.text: Thus, going along the road, the Ocean of the rasa of compassion chanted His own names, His sweet lips shining.
verses_en.orig:
एवमेवं पथि चलन्मधुराधररोचिषा ।
जजाप निजनामानि करुणारससागरः ॥६१॥ (असंयोगः)
verses_en.translit:
evam evaṁ pathi calan madhurādhara-rociṣā |
jajāpa nija-nāmāni karuṇā-rasa-sāgaraḥ ||61|| (asaṁyogaḥ)
verses_en.wbw: evam evam — thus, thus; pathi — on the road; calan — going; madhura — sweet; adhara — of the lips; rociṣā — with the radiance; jajāpa — chanted; nija — His own; nāmāni — names; karuṇā — of compassion; rasa — of the rasa; sāgaraḥ — the Ocean.
notes: An asaṁyoga: a verse without consonant clusters. Only at the word junction calan madhura- do n and m meet (written in the Devanagari as the ligature न्म).

verses_en.text: Going along thus and seeing a charming lodging by the river, He who is beautiful with sweet lips said, singing sweetly:
verses_en.orig:
एवं व्रजन्नुपनदि वीक्ष्यावासं मनोरमम् ।
ऊचेऽनुगायन्मधुरं मधुराधरसुन्दरः ॥६२॥
verses_en.translit:
evaṁ vrajann upanadi vīkṣyāvāsaṁ manoramam |
ūce 'nugāyan madhuraṁ madhurādhara-sundaraḥ ||62||
verses_en.wbw: evam — thus; vrajan — going; upanadi — by the river; vīkṣya — having seen; āvāsam — a lodging; manoramam — charming; ūce — said; anugāyan — singing; madhuram — sweetly; madhura — sweet; adhara — with lips; sundaraḥ — beautiful.

verses_en.text: "You go on ahead. There, in the country of Kataka, you will see Me [again] in the temple of the Lord of the gopis."
verses_en.orig:
अग्रे गच्छत यूयं तु कटके तत्र नीवृति ।
दर्शनं मम गोपीशप्रासादेषु भविष्यति ॥६३॥
verses_en.translit:
agre gacchata yūyaṁ tu kaṭake tatra nīvṛti |
darśanaṁ mama gopīśa-prāsādeṣu bhaviṣyati ||63||
verses_en.wbw: agre — ahead; gacchata — go; yūyam tu — you; kaṭake — in Kataka; tatra — there; nīvṛti — in the country; darśanam — the sight; mama — of Me; gopīśa — of the Lord of the gopis; prāsādeṣu — in the temple; bhaviṣyati — will be.
notes: Kataka (Cuttack) was then the capital of Orissa; the Lord of the gopis is Gopinatha, that is, Sakshi-gopala (cf. 11.79). In the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 16.100) the Lord at Kataka visits the temple of Gopala, and the brahmana Svapneshvara invites Him for a meal.

verses_en.text: Thus instructed, those great souls — Puri and the others — then went off, while Gauranga rested there with someone [of His companions].
verses_en.orig:
इत्युक्तास्ते महात्मानः पुरीप्रभृतयस्तदा ।
प्रययुस्तत्र गौराङ्गो विशश्रामाथ केनचित् ॥६४॥
verses_en.translit:
ity uktās te mahātmānaḥ purī-prabhṛtayas tadā |
prayayus tatra gaurāṅgo viśaśrāmātha kenacit ||64||
verses_en.wbw: iti — thus; uktāḥ — told; te — those; mahā-ātmānaḥ — great souls; purī — Puri; prabhṛtayaḥ — and the others; tadā — then; prayayuḥ — went off; tatra — there; gaurāṅgaḥ — Gauranga; viśaśrāma — rested; atha — and; kenacit — with someone.
notes: Kenacit may also mean "for a while" ⟨?⟩.

verses_en.text: Hearing, "The Ocean of Mercy is coming," the lord of elephants by his command had every landing-place tended by [his people's] hands.
verses_en.orig:
आयाति करुणासिन्धुरिति श्रुत्वा गजेश्वरः ।
आज्ञया सकलं तीर्थं चकार करलालितम् ॥६५॥
(निरोष्ठ्यः)
verses_en.translit:
āyāti karuṇā-sindhur iti śrutvā gajeśvaraḥ |
ājñayā sakalaṁ tīrthaṁ cakāra kara-lālitam ||65||
(niroṣṭhyaḥ)
verses_en.wbw: āyāti — is coming; karuṇā — of mercy; sindhuḥ — the Ocean; iti — thus; śrutvā — having heard; gaja-īśvaraḥ — the lord of elephants (the Gajapati); ājñayā — by [his] command; sakalam — every; tīrtham — landing-place; cakāra — made; kara — by hands; lālitam — tended.
notes: A niroṣṭhya: a verse without labial consonants (p, ph, b, bh, m; the anusvara is not counted). The semivowel v (in śrutvā, gajeśvaraḥ), being dento-labial, is evidently not reckoned as labial, nor is the vowel u (in karuṇā, sindhuḥ). The "lord of elephants" is the Gajapati, the title of the kings of Orissa — here Prataparudra. Tīrtha — a landing-place or ford for crossing a river. Cf. Chaitanya-charitamrita, Madhya 16.112–116: the king orders houses and new boats to be made ready for the Lord at the crossings, and memorial pillars to be set up.

verses_en.text: Gopinatha, with ornaments covering all His limbs, possessing sweetness, vigour and clarity, shone like a poet's play of words.
verses_en.orig:
सर्वाङ्गीनैरलङ्कारैर्माधुर्य्यौजःप्रसादवान् ।
गोपीनाथो रराजासौ वाग्विलासः कवेरिव ॥६६॥
verses_en.translit:
sarvāṅgīnair alaṅkārair mādhuryaujaḥ-prasādavān |
gopīnātho rarājāsau vāg-vilāsaḥ kaver iva ||66||
verses_en.wbw: sarva-aṅgīnaiḥ — covering all the limbs; alaṅkāraiḥ — with ornaments; mādhurya — sweetness; ojaḥ — vigour; prasāda — [and] clarity; vān — possessing; gopīnāthaḥ — Gopinatha; rarāja — shone; asau — He; vāk — of words; vilāsaḥ — the play; kaveḥ — of a poet; iva — like.
notes: A double meaning: alaṅkāra is both "ornament" and "figure of speech", and mādhurya, ojas and prasāda are the three excellences (guṇa) of poetic diction. The edition's Sanskrit commentary explains: mādhurya is the delight that melts the heart; ojas is the brilliance that expands the heart (in the heroic, the loathsome and the furious rasas); prasāda is that which pervades the heart at once, as fire seizes dry wood.

verses_en.text: Having attained a youthful longing, continually new and ever new, the charming king shone like [the month of] Chaitra accompanied by beauty.
verses_en.orig:
उत्कण्ठां तरुणीं प्राप्य निरन्तरनवां नवाम् ।
रराज राजा मधुरः सश्रीक इव चैत्रिकः ॥६७॥
verses_en.translit:
utkaṇṭhāṁ taruṇīṁ prāpya nirantara-navāṁ navām |
rarāja rājā madhuraḥ saśrīka iva caitrikaḥ ||67||
verses_en.wbw: utkaṇṭhām — longing; taruṇīm — youthful (also: a young woman); prāpya — having attained; nirantara — continually; navām navām — new and ever new; rarāja — shone; rājā — the king; madhuraḥ — charming (also: vernal); sa-śrīkaḥ — with Shri (beauty); iva — like; caitrikaḥ — the [month of] Chaitra.
notes: A double meaning: taruṇī is also "a young woman", and madhura also "vernal" (madhu — spring; Madhu is another name of the month of Chaitra): like spring united with beauty, the king was united with a fresh longing as with a young bride. The king is not named; probably Prataparudra is meant (cf. 65 and 81 ff.) ⟨?⟩.

verses_en.text: Then these great souls, joyful, their faces beaming with contentment, entered the temple of the great Lord Gopinatha.
verses_en.orig:
तत एते महात्मानो गोपीनाथमहाप्रभोः ।
प्रासादं विविशुर्हृष्टाः प्रसादोल्लसिताननाः ॥६८॥
verses_en.translit:
tata ete mahātmāno gopīnātha-mahāprabhoḥ |
prāsādaṁ viviśur hṛṣṭāḥ prasādollasitānanāḥ ||68||
verses_en.wbw: tataḥ — then; ete — these; mahā-ātmānaḥ — great souls; gopīnātha — Gopinatha; mahāprabhoḥ — of the great Lord; prāsādam — the temple; viviśuḥ — entered; hṛṣṭāḥ — joyful; prasāda — with contentment; ullasita — beaming; ānanāḥ — [with] faces.
notes: A play on prāsāda (temple) and prasāda (contentment, grace).

verses_en.text: There [the doorkeepers], canes swinging in their hands, with great joy led them — who had forgotten all other desires — into the inner chamber.
verses_en.orig:
तत्र तान् परया प्रीत्या वेत्रवेल्लितपाणयः ।
अनयन्नन्तरं वेश्म विस्मृतान्यमनोरथान् ॥६९॥
verses_en.translit:
tatra tān parayā prītyā vetra-vellita-pāṇayaḥ |
anayann antaraṁ veśma vismṛtānya-manorathān ||69||
verses_en.wbw: tatra — there; tān — them; parayā — with great; prītyā — joy; vetra — canes; vellita — swinging; pāṇayaḥ — [whose] hands; anayan — led; antaram — inner; veśma — into the chamber; vismṛta — who had forgotten; anya — other; manorathān — desires.

verses_en.text: Seeing Him with love, they attained the very greatest joy. Then a certain local brahmana came and invited Paramananda Puri there for a meal.
verses_en.orig:
ते विलोक्याथ तं प्रेम्णा प्रीतिमापुर्महत्तराम् ।
अथ कश्चित् समागत्य तत्रत्यः पृथिवीसुरः ।
भिक्षार्थमवृणोत्तत्र परमानन्दपूरिणम् ॥७०॥
verses_en.translit:
te vilokyātha taṁ premṇā prītim āpur mahattarām |
atha kaścit samāgatya tatratyaḥ pṛthivī-suraḥ |
bhikṣārtham avṛṇot tatra paramānanda-pūriṇam ||70||
verses_en.wbw: te — they; vilokya — having seen; atha — then; tam — Him; premṇā — with love; prītim — joy; āpuḥ — attained; mahattarām — the very greatest; atha — then; kaścit — a certain; samāgatya — having come; tatratyaḥ — local; pṛthivī-suraḥ — god on earth (brahmana); bhikṣā-artham — for a meal; avṛṇot — invited; tatra — there; paramānanda-pūriṇam — Paramananda Puri.
notes: The verse has three lines (six padas) — perhaps a half-verse of a neighbouring verse merged with it in typesetting ⟨?⟩; all six padas are metrically regular. The Gosvami edition (GGM) has the same text.

verses_en.text: Meanwhile Gaurachandra came, shining like millions of moons, resembling a blazing golden mountain — like the rising of good fortune.
verses_en.orig:
अत्रान्तरे गौरचन्द्रश्चन्द्रकोटिसमुज्ज्वलः ।
ज्वलत्काञ्चनशैलाभो लाभोदय इवागमत् ॥७१॥
verses_en.translit:
atrāntare gauracandraś candra-koṭi-samujjvalaḥ |
jvalat-kāñcana-śailābho lābhodaya ivāgamat ||71||
verses_en.wbw: atra antare — meanwhile; gauracandraḥ — Gaurachandra; candra — of moons; koṭi — [like] millions; samujjvalaḥ — shining brightly; jvalat — of a blazing; kāñcana — golden; śaila — mountain; ābhaḥ — [having] the appearance; lābha — of good fortune; udayaḥ — the rising; iva — like; āgamat — came.
notes: A chain of repetitions at the junctions of words: each word picks up the sound of the end of the preceding one (-candraś candra-, -ujjvalaḥ jvalat-, -ābho lābho-).

verses_en.text: Having long beheld charming Gopinatha, who was like a heart's desire embodied, the Ocean of Mercy was filled with joy there.
verses_en.orig:
दृष्ट्वा चिरं कृपासिन्धुर्गोपीनाथं मनोरमम् ।
मनोरथं मूर्त्तिमन्तमिव तत्र मुदं ययौ ॥७२॥
verses_en.translit:
dṛṣṭvā ciraṁ kṛpā-sindhur gopīnāthaṁ manoramam |
manorathaṁ mūrttimantam iva tatra mudaṁ yayau ||72||
verses_en.wbw: dṛṣṭvā — having beheld; ciram — for a long time; kṛpā — of mercy; sindhuḥ — the Ocean; gopīnātham — Gopinatha; manoramam — charming; manoratham — a heart's desire; mūrttimantam — embodied; iva — like; tatra — there; mudam — joy; yayau — attained.
notes: Manoramam / manoratham — a play on similar sounds.

verses_en.text: Then this same god on earth, the brahmana named Svapneshvara, invited [the Lord] there for a meal and also brought [Him] to his house.
verses_en.orig:
अथ स्वप्नेश्वरो नाम सोऽयं धरणिदैवतम् ।
भिक्षार्थमवृणोत्तत्र गृहेऽपि च समानयत् ॥७३॥
verses_en.translit:
atha svapneśvaro nāma so 'yaṁ dharaṇi-daivatam |
bhikṣārtham avṛṇot tatra gṛhe 'pi ca samānayat ||73||
verses_en.wbw: atha — then; svapneśvaraḥ nāma — named Svapneshvara; saḥ ayam — this same; dharaṇi — of the earth; daivatam — god (a brahmana); bhikṣā-artham — for a meal; avṛṇot — invited; tatra — there; gṛhe — to [his] house; api ca — and also; samānayat — brought.
notes: So 'yam, "this same", presumably points to the brahmana of verse 70. In the Chaitanya-charitamrita (Madhya 16.100) the brahmana Svapneshvara invites the Lord to a meal at Kataka, and afterwards the Lord rests beneath a bakula tree (16.102).

verses_en.text: But the others, headed by Jagadananda, devoted to bliss, Sri Ramananda Raya led to his own house.
verses_en.orig:
अन्यांस्तु जगदानन्दमुख्यान् सुखपरायणान् ।
श्रीरामानन्दरायोऽसौ निनाय निजमन्दिरम् ॥७४॥
verses_en.translit:
anyāṁs tu jagadānanda-mukhyān sukha-parāyaṇān |
śrī-rāmānanda-rāyo 'sau nināya nija-mandiram ||74||
verses_en.wbw: anyān tu — but the others; jagadānanda-mukhyān — headed by Jagadananda; sukha — to bliss; parāyaṇān — devoted; śrī-rāmānanda-rāyaḥ — Sri Ramananda Raya; asau — he; nināya — led; nija — to his own; mandiram — house.

verses_en.text:
Word for word (following the edition's commentary). First line: āgāra — for the house; āhitya — [of] being beneficial; sukha-de — giving the pleasure; manorāme — charming. Second line: āga (= aga, "mountain") — of the mountains; arāhitya — inseparable [pleasure], i.e. the pleasure of hill country (pārvatya-sukha); sukha-de — giving; sadā-ārāme — to a fine garden; tadā — then; ānayat — brought; saḥ — he; tān — them; atha — then.
Then he brought them at that time to a fine garden — charming, giving the pleasure of being beneficial to the household, and giving the unfailing pleasure of hill country ⟨?⟩.
verses_en.orig:
आगाराहित्यसुखदे मनोरामे स तानथ ।
आगाराहित्यसुखदे सदारामे तदानयत् ॥७५॥
verses_en.translit:
āgārāhitya-sukhade manorāme sa tān atha |
āgārāhitya-sukhade sadārāme tadānayat ||75||
notes: Yamaka: the two lines open with the same sequence of syllables (āgārāhitya-sukhade), which is divided and understood differently in each. The analysis of the edition's Sanskrit commentary: hitaṁ karotīti hityam ("that which does good", with the suffix yat); na gacchantīti agāḥ, "those that do not move", i.e. mountains, with the suffix aṇ giving āgāḥ; sadārāma is an excellent garden near a house. The translation is tentative ⟨?⟩. The Gosvami edition (GGM) has the same text.

verses_en.text: Having made them glad with the delights of the garden, Ramananda, who causes people to exult with joy, then quickly went to the king.
verses_en.orig:
आरामारामललितान् कृत्वा तानथ सत्वरम् ।
रामानन्दो जनानन्दोल्लासकृद्भूपमासदत् ॥७६॥
verses_en.translit:
ārāmārāma-lalitān kṛtvā tān atha satvaram |
rāmānando janānandollāsa-kṛd bhūpam āsadat ||76||
verses_en.wbw: ārāma — of the garden; ārāma — with the delight; lalitān — gladdened; kṛtvā — having made; tān — them; atha — then; satvaram — quickly; rāmānandaḥ — Ramananda; jana — of people; ānanda — of the joy; ullāsa — the exultation; kṛt — causing; bhūpam — to the king; āsadat — went.
notes: A play on sounds: ārāmārāma-, rāmānando janānando-.

verses_en.text: After resting, they set about cooking there; and Puri Svami, having taken his meal, came there with the Lord.
verses_en.orig:
ते तत्र रन्धनोद्योगं चक्रुर्विश्रमणान्तरम् ।
कृतभिक्षः पुरीस्वामी प्रभुना तत्र चागमत् ॥७७॥
verses_en.translit:
te tatra randhanodyogaṁ cakrur viśramaṇāntaram |
kṛta-bhikṣaḥ purī-svāmī prabhuṇā tatra cāgamat ||77||
verses_en.wbw: te — they; tatra — there; randhana — for cooking; udyogam — preparations; cakruḥ — made; viśramaṇa — rest; antaram — after; kṛta — having taken; bhikṣaḥ — [his] meal; purī-svāmī — Puri Svami; prabhuṇā — with the Lord; tatra — there; ca — and; āgamat — came.
notes: The edition misprints randhona-; read randhana-, "cooking" (so the text above). Puri Svami is Paramananda Puri, who was invited to a meal in verse 70.

verses_en.text: There, in the middle of the garden, is a tall bakula tree — spreading, with dense shade, a vakula-druma among the families [of trees] ⟨?⟩.
verses_en.orig:
तत्रोपवनमध्येऽस्ति सूच्छ्रितो वकुलद्रुमः ।
विसारी निबिडच्छायः कुलानां वकुलद्रुमः ॥७८॥
verses_en.translit:
tatropavana-madhye 'sti sūcchrito vakula-drumaḥ |
visārī nibiḍa-cchāyaḥ kulānāṁ vakula-drumaḥ (? bakula = ba-kula / kubera) ||78||
verses_en.wbw: tatra — there; upavana — of the garden; madhye — in the middle; asti — there is; su-ucchritaḥ — tall; vakula-drumaḥ — a bakula tree; visārī — spreading; nibiḍa — dense; chāyaḥ — [whose] shade [is]; kulānām — among the families [of trees]; vakula-drumaḥ — ⟨?⟩ (see the note).
notes: The second vakula-drumaḥ repeats the first (yamaka) with a different, unclear sense ⟨?⟩. One interpretation, noted in the IAST line, connects it with Kubera: "among the trees of its kind this bakula was rich as Kubera", i.e. like a wish-fulfilling tree. Since va is listed in the lexicons as a particle equal to iva, "like", the words can perhaps also be divided kulānāṁ va kula-drumaḥ, "like the head tree (kula-druma) of the families [of trees]" ⟨?⟩. The Gosvami edition (GGM) has the same text.

karnapura-ckm.title: Пратапарудра в Катаке; переправа в Чатурдвару
karnapura-ckm.summary: Пратапарудра приходит с четырёхчастным войском, падает к стопам Господа, плачет и катается по земле; он велит Мангарадже и Харичандане сопровождать Господа за Маханади и ставить памятные столбы; Господь ночует в Чатурдваре.

verses.text: Тем временем венец круга царей, исполненный великой славы, совершил торжественный выезд туда, чтобы увидеть стопы Гаурачандры.
verses.orig:
अत्रान्तरे गुरुश्रीको भूपचक्रशिरोमणिः ।
विजयं गौरचन्द्राङ्घ्रिदृष्टये तत्र चकार सः ॥८१॥
verses.translit:
atrāntare guru-śrīko bhūpa-cakra-śiromaṇiḥ |
vijayaṁ gauracandrāṅghri-dṛṣṭaye tatra cakāra saḥ ||81||
verses.wbw: atra antare — тем временем; guru — великой; śrīkaḥ — [с] славой; bhūpa — царей; cakra — круга; śiraḥ-maṇiḥ — венец; vijayam — торжественный выезд; gauracandra — Гаурачандры; aṅghri — стопы; dṛṣṭaye — чтобы увидеть; tatra — туда; cakāra — совершил; saḥ — он.

verses.text: Вместе с Раманандой — словно Смара с Весной, — с четырёхчастным войском, он затем вовремя прибыл.
verses.orig:
रामानन्दसहायः स सवसन्त इव स्मरः ।
चतुरङ्गबलैर्युक्तः समयात् समयात्ततः ॥८२॥
verses.translit:
rāmānanda-sahāyaḥ sa savasanta iva smaraḥ |
catur-aṅga-balair yuktaḥ samayāt samayāt tataḥ ||82||
verses.wbw: rāmānanda — Раманандой; sahāyaḥ — [сопровождаемый] спутником; saḥ — он; sa-vasantaḥ — с Весной; iva — как; smaraḥ — Смара (Кама); catuḥ-aṅga — четырёхчастным; balaiḥ — войском; yuktaḥ — с; samayāt — вовремя; samayāt — прибыл; tataḥ — затем.
notes: Четыре части войска — слоны, кони, колесницы, пехота. Игра: samayāt «вовремя» / sam-ayāt «прибыл».

verses.text: Сойдя со спины слона, прекраснейший, с плечами, как у слона, он радостно шёл к тому саду пешком и весьма блистал.
verses.orig:
अवतीर्य गजस्कन्धात् गजस्कन्धातिसुन्दरः ।
तदारामं प्रति प्रीत्या भूमौ गच्छन् बभौ भृशम् ॥८३॥
verses.translit:
avatīrya gaja-skandhāt gaja-skandhāti-sundaraḥ |
tad-ārāmaṁ prati prītyā bhūmau gacchan babhau bhṛśam ||83||
verses.wbw: avatīrya — сойдя; gaja — слона; skandhāt — со спины; gaja — как у слона; skandha — [с] плечами; ati-sundaraḥ — прекраснейший; tat — к тому; ārāmam prati — саду; prītyā — с радостью; bhūmau — по земле; gacchan — идущий; babhau — блистал; bhṛśam — весьма.

verses.text: Окружённый огромными слонами, всегда истекающими мускусом, — подвижными [как не-горы], — конями и богатством передвигающейся пехоты, он всё больше блистал.
verses.orig:
सदा सदानैर्गुरुभिर्नागैर्नागैर्हयैर्वृतः ।
पत्तिसंपत्तिसञ्चार्यैर्भूयो भूयो रराज सः ॥८४॥
verses.translit:
sadā sadānair gurubhir nāgair nāgair hayair vṛtaḥ |
patti-saṁpatti-sañcāryair bhūyo bhūyo rarāja saḥ ||84||
verses.wbw: sadā — всегда; sa-dānaiḥ — с мускусом (текущим соком); gurubhiḥ — огромными; nāgaiḥ — слонами; nāgaiḥ (= na-agaiḥ) — подвижными (букв. «не неподвижными»); hayaiḥ — конями; vṛtaḥ — окружённый; patti — пехоты; saṁpatti — богатством; sañcāryaiḥ — передвигающимися; bhūyaḥ bhūyaḥ — всё больше; rarāja — блистал; saḥ — он.
notes: Nāgair nāgair: первое — «слонами», второе, по хинди, «своевольными» (na-aga — «не неподвижный»). Dāna — сок, текущий из висков слона во время муста.

verses.text: «Нет равного ему царя ни на небе, ни на земле», — словно возвещая так, высокие кони повсюду там взрывали [землю] копытами.
verses.orig:
नास्त्येवास्य समो राजा किं स्वर्गे किं महीतले ।
इतीव तत्र तत्रोच्चैः क्षुरैरक्षोभि घोटकैः ॥८५॥
verses.translit:
nāsty evāsya samo rājā kiṁ svarge kiṁ mahī-tale |
itīva tatra tatroccaiḥ kṣurair akṣobhi ghoṭakaiḥ ||85||
verses.wbw: na asti eva — нет вовсе; asya — ему; samaḥ — равного; rājā — царя; kim svarge — ни на небе; kim mahī-tale — ни на земле; iti iva — словно [возвещая] так; tatra tatra — повсюду там; uccaiḥ — высокие; kṣuraiḥ — копытами; akṣobhi — была взрыта [земля]; ghoṭakaiḥ — конями.

verses.text: Взяв Рамананду за руку и расставив кругом толпу министров, царь шёл, как полная луна, соединённая с солнцем.
verses.orig:
रामानन्दभुजं धृत्वा नियोज्यामात्यसञ्चयम् ।
अभितोऽभिययौ राजा पूर्णचन्द्रोऽर्कयुग्यथा ॥८६॥
verses.translit:
rāmānanda-bhujaṁ dhṛtvā niyojyāmātya-sañcayam |
abhito 'bhiyayau rājā pūrṇa-candro 'rka-yug yathā ||86||
verses.wbw: rāmānanda — Рамананды; bhujam — руку; dhṛtvā — взяв; niyojya — расставив; amātya — министров; sañcayam — толпу; abhitaḥ — кругом; abhiyayau — шёл; rājā — царь; pūrṇa-candraḥ — полная луна; arka — с солнцем; yuk — соединённая; yathā — как.

verses.text: Сначала место на земле, опоясанное кольцом подобных богам министров, разместившихся внутри войска, блистало.
verses.orig:
अमात्यैरमरप्रायैरन्तर्बलनिवेशिभिः ।
प्रथमं वलयीभूतो भूप्रदेशो रराज सः ॥८७॥
verses.translit:
amātyair amara-prāyair antar-bala-niveśibhiḥ |
prathamaṁ valayībhūto bhū-pradeśo rarāja saḥ ||87||
verses.wbw: amātyaiḥ — министрами; amara — богам; prāyaiḥ — подобными; antaḥ — внутри; bala — войска; niveśibhiḥ — разместившимися; prathamam — сначала; valayībhūtaḥ — опоясанное кольцом; bhū-pradeśaḥ — место на земле; rarāja — блистало; saḥ — то.
notes: Издание приводит разночтение antar-vana-nivāsibhiḥ («живущими в лесу») и отвергает его: «это чтение нехорошо».

verses.text: Снаружи того стояли пехотинцы, снаружи их — множество коней, а снаружи — все слоны: тогда образовался настоящий боевой строй.
verses.orig:
तद्बहिः पत्तयोऽतिष्ठंस्तद्बहिर्हयसञ्चयः ।
तद्बहिश्च गजाः सर्वे व्यूह एवाभवत्तदा ॥८८॥
verses.translit:
tad-bahiḥ pattayo 'tiṣṭhaṁs tad-bahir haya-sañcayaḥ |
tad-bahiś ca gajāḥ sarve vyūha evābhavat tadā ||88||
verses.wbw: tat-bahiḥ — снаружи того; pattayaḥ — пехотинцы; atiṣṭhan — стояли; tat-bahiḥ — снаружи того; haya — коней; sañcayaḥ — множество; tat-bahiḥ ca — и снаружи того; gajāḥ — слоны; sarve — все; vyūhaḥ eva — [настоящий] боевой строй; abhavat — образовался; tadā — тогда.
notes: Ср. три круга вокруг пляшущего Господа в 16.24.

verses.text: Увидев там пару лотосных стоп, царь с тающим сердцем вновь и вновь падал на землю вместе со слезами радости.
verses.orig:
पादारविन्दयुगलं वीक्ष्य तत्र द्रवन्मनाः ।
भूपतिर्भूतलं भूयः प्राप हर्षाश्रुणा सह ॥८९॥
(असन्ध्यक्षरः)
verses.translit:
pādāravinda-yugalaṁ vīkṣya tatra dravan-manāḥ |
bhūpatir bhū-talaṁ bhūyaḥ prāpa harṣāśruṇā saha ||89||
(asandhy-akṣaraḥ)
verses.wbw: pāda — стоп; aravinda — лотосов; yugalam — пару; vīkṣya — увидев; tatra — там; dravat — тающим; manāḥ — [с] сердцем; bhū-patiḥ — царь; bhū-talam — земли; bhūyaḥ — снова; prāpa — достиг (пал на); harṣa — радости; aśruṇā — слезой; saha — вместе.
notes: Асандхьякшара — стих без дифтонгов (e, ai, o, au). Хинди: «и слёзы царя падали на землю, и сам царь катался по земле». Ср. ЧЧ Мадхья 16.102–107: пока Господь спит под деревом бакула, Рамананда приводит царя, тот падает к Его стопам и возносит молитвы.

verses.text: Многократно поклонившись, царь пил глазами лотос Его лица и не мог насытиться. Дивно деяние Гауранги!
verses.orig:
प्रणम्य बहुधा दृग्भ्यामपिबद्वदनाम्बुजम् ।
न च तृप्तिमगाद्भूपश्चित्रं गौराङ्गचेष्टितम् ॥९०॥
verses.translit:
praṇamya bahudhā dṛgbhyām apibad vadanāmbujam |
na ca tṛptim agād bhūpaś citraṁ gaurāṅga-ceṣṭitam ||90||
verses.wbw: praṇamya — поклонившись; bahudhā — многократно; dṛgbhyām — глазами; apibat — пил; vadana — лица; ambujam — лотос; na ca — и не; tṛptim — насыщения; agāt — достиг; bhūpaḥ — царь; citram — дивно; gaurāṅga — Гауранги; ceṣṭitam — деяние.
notes: Издание указывает разночтение na tṛptim agamad bhūpaḥ.

verses.text: И Гаурачандра, многократно с любовью заговаривая с ним, оросил нектаром слов всё его тело, — словно обнимая всем телом.
verses.orig:
बहुधा गौरचन्द्रोऽपि प्रेम्णाभाष्य वचोऽमृतैः ।
सिषेच तस्य सर्वाङ्गं सर्वाङ्गीनमिवाश्लिषन् ॥९१॥
verses.translit:
bahudhā gauracandro 'pi premṇābhāṣya vaco-'mṛtaiḥ |
siṣeca tasya sarvāṅgaṁ sarvāṅgīnam ivāśliṣan ||91||
verses.wbw: bahudhā — многократно; gauracandraḥ api — и Гаурачандра; premṇā — с любовью; ābhāṣya — заговорив; vacaḥ — слов; amṛtaiḥ — нектаром; siṣeca — оросил; tasya — его; sarva-aṅgam — всё тело; sarva-aṅgīnam — всем телом; iva — словно; āśliṣan — обнимая.

verses.text: Восприняв повеление и милость, исполнив должное, он удалился; затем все толпы министров поспешно пошли увидеть [Господа].
verses.orig:
आज्ञायाज्ञां प्रसादं च कृतकृत्यः स निर्ययौ ।
अमात्यनिचयाः सर्वे ततो द्रष्टुं ययुर्द्रुतम् ॥९२॥
verses.translit:
ājñāyājñāṁ prasādaṁ ca kṛta-kṛtyaḥ sa niryayau |
amātya-nicayāḥ sarve tato draṣṭuṁ yayur drutam ||92||
verses.wbw: ājñāya — восприняв; ājñām — повеление; prasādam — милость; ca — и; kṛta-kṛtyaḥ — исполнивший должное; saḥ — он; niryayau — удалился; amātya — министров; nicayāḥ — толпы; sarve — все; tataḥ — затем; draṣṭum — увидеть; yayuḥ — пошли; drutam — поспешно.

verses.text: Узнав намерение [Господа], желающего идти за Читротпалу, — словно в океан за пёстрыми лотосами, — царь сказал одному достойному [слуге]:
verses.orig:
पारेचित्रोत्पलं सोऽकूपारे चित्रोत्पलं यथा ।
यियासोः स्वमतं ज्ञात्वा भूपः सत्पात्रमब्रवीत् ॥९३॥
(पद्मभेदः)
verses.translit:
pāre-citrotpalaṁ so 'kūpāre citrotpalaṁ yathā |
yiyāsoḥ svamataṁ jñātvā bhūpaḥ sat-pātram abravīt ||93||
(padma-bhedaḥ)
verses.wbw: pāre-citrotpalam — за рекой Читротпалой; saḥ — он; akūpāre — в океан; citra-utpalam yathā — словно за пёстрыми лотосами; yiyāsoḥ — желающего идти; svamatam — намерение; jñātvā — узнав; bhūpaḥ — царь; sat-pātram — достойному человеку; abravīt — сказал.
notes: Падма-бхеда — стих, слоги которого складываются в узор лотоса. Читротпала — река (Читраутпала, рукав Маханади). Санскритский комментарий: pāre-citrotpalam — авьяйибхава по правилу «pāre и madhye — с родительным падежом»; akūpāra — океан (по «Амаракоше»). Хинди: «царь, словно поняв мысль Гаурачандры — „Господь, вероятно, пойдёт за реку Читротпалу, будто к океану собирать пёстрые лотосы“, — дал приказ слуге по имени Мангараджа».

verses.text: «Мангараджа, ты же вместе с Харичанданой поспешно сопроводите Махапрабху за Маханади».
verses.orig:
मङ्गराज भवानेव हरिचन्दनसंगतः ।
पारेमहानदि महाप्रभुमन्वेतु सत्वरम् ॥९४॥
verses.translit:
maṅgarāja bhavān eva haricandana-saṁgataḥ |
pāre-mahānadi mahāprabhum anvetu satvaram ||94||
verses.wbw: maṅgarāja — о Мангараджа; bhavān — вы; eva — же; haricandana — с Харичанданой; saṁgataḥ — вместе; pāre-mahānadi — за Маханади; mahāprabhum — Махапрабху; anvetu — сопроводите; satvaram — поспешно.
notes: В издании bhavānena; издание Госвами (GGM) читает bhavān eva — так и читаем. Мангараджа и Харичандана — царские чиновники; ср. ЧЧ Мадхья 16.113, 126: царь поручает Харичандане и Мангарадже служить Господу, и они вместе с Раманандой следуют за Ним.

verses.text: По его приказу они и Шри Рамананда Рай снарядили огромные лодки и переправили Господа.
verses.orig:
तदाज्ञयाथ ते सोऽपि श्रीरामानन्दरायकः ।
नौकाः सुमहतीश्चक्रे प्रभुं चाथ समानयन् ॥९५॥
verses.translit:
tad-ājñayātha te so 'pi śrī-rāmānanda-rāyakaḥ |
naukāḥ sumahatīś cakre prabhuṁ cātha samānayan ||95||
verses.wbw: tat-ājñayā — по его приказу; atha — затем; te — они; saḥ api — и тот; śrī-rāmānanda-rāyakaḥ — Шри Рамананда Рай; naukāḥ — лодки; su-mahatīḥ — огромные; cakre — снарядил; prabhum — Господа; ca — и; atha — затем; samānayan — переправили.

verses.text: Тогда взошла божественная полная луна, отмеченная ланью, и своими лучами-руками вымела весь путь.
verses.orig:
उदियाय तदा पूर्णो भगवान् मृगलाञ्छनः ।
करैः सम्मार्जयामास पन्थानमखिलं ततः ॥९६॥
verses.translit:
udiyāya tadā pūrṇo bhagavān mṛga-lāñchanaḥ |
karaiḥ sammārjayāmāsa panthānam akhilaṁ tataḥ ||96||
verses.wbw: udiyāya — взошла; tadā — тогда; pūrṇaḥ — полная; bhagavān — божественная; mṛga — ланью; lāñchanaḥ — отмеченная (луна); karaiḥ — лучами (= руками); sammārjayāmāsa — вымела; panthānam — путь; akhilam — весь; tataḥ — затем.

verses.text: Затем, когда Гауранга уходил, пришедший тогда царский слуга, определив [место], объявил там тамошним людям приказ царя:
verses.orig:
ततो गच्छति गौराङ्गे राजकीयस्तदागतः ।
तत्रत्यांस्तत्र निर्णीय तदाज्ञां निजगाद सः ॥९७॥
verses.translit:
tato gacchati gaurāṅge rājakīyas tadāgataḥ |
tatratyāṁs tatra nirṇīya tad-ājñāṁ nijagāda saḥ ||97||
verses.wbw: tataḥ — затем; gacchati — [когда] уходил; gaurāṅge — Гауранга; rājakīyaḥ — царский [слуга]; tadā — тогда; āgataḥ — пришедший; tatratyān — тамошним [людям]; tatra — там; nirṇīya — определив; tat — его (царя); ājñām — приказ; nijagāda — объявил; saḥ — он.

verses.text: «Слушайте, почтеннейшие, что повелевает государь: здесь должен быть воздвигнут столб, чтобы это место стало святым».
verses.orig:
आज्ञापयति देवो यच्छ्रूयतां तन्महोत्तमाः ।
आरोप्योऽत्र स्तम्भ एको येन तीर्थं भवेदिदम् ॥९८॥
verses.translit:
ājñāpayati devo yac chrūyatāṁ tan mahottamāḥ |
āropyo 'tra stambha eko yena tīrthaṁ bhaved idam ||98||
verses.wbw: ājñāpayati — повелевает; devaḥ — государь; yat — что; śrūyatām — слушайте; tat — то; mahā-uttamāḥ — о почтеннейшие; āropyaḥ — должен быть воздвигнут; atra — здесь; stambhaḥ — столб; ekaḥ — один; yena — чтобы; tīrtham — святым местом; bhavet — стало; idam — это.
notes: Ср. ЧЧ Мадхья 16.115: Пратапарудра велит ставить памятную колонну в каждом месте, где Господь омоется или переправится.

verses.text: Услышав такой приказ царя, они воздвигли там столб и, посадив Господа в лодку, радостно служили Ему.
verses.orig:
इति श्रुत्वा नृपाज्ञां ते स्तम्भमारोप्य तत्र च ।
नौकामारोप्यो मुदिताः प्रभुं हर्षादुपासत ॥९९॥
verses.translit:
iti śrutvā nṛpājñāṁ te stambham āropya tatra ca |
naukām āropyo (āropya) muditāḥ prabhuṁ harṣād upāsata ||99||
verses.wbw: iti — так; śrutvā — услышав; nṛpa — царя; ājñām — приказ; te — они; stambham — столб; āropya — воздвигнув; tatra — там; ca — и; naukām — в лодку; āropya — посадив; muditāḥ — радостные; prabhum — Господу; harṣāt — с радостью; upāsata — служили.
notes: В издании āropyo — опечатка вместо āropya.

Yamaka: paramānena is repeated, and rājī vanasya is echoed in rājīva. The edition notes a variant: instead of paramānena lalitā paramānena sarvataḥ — pavamānena lalitā pavamānena sarvataḥ, "charming by the breeze, the breeze [blowing gently] from all sides". The sense of the verse is unclear ⟨?⟩. The Gosvami edition (GGM) has the same text.

verses_en.text: Staying at the foot of the bakula tree, He shone with a beautiful smile, and with this golden form of His He conquered the jambu tree.
verses_en.orig:
वकुलद्रुममूलेऽसौ वसन् भाति स्म सुस्मितः ।
अनेन हेमरूपेण जम्बुवृक्षं जिगाय सः ॥८०॥
verses_en.translit:
vakula-druma-mūle 'sau vasan bhāti sma susmitaḥ |
anena hema-rūpeṇa jambu-vṛkṣaṁ jigāya saḥ ||80||
verses_en.wbw: vakula — of the bakula; druma — tree; mūle — at the foot; asau — He; vasan — staying; bhāti sma — shone; su-smitaḥ — smiling beautifully; anena — by this; hema — golden; rūpeṇa — form; jambu-vṛkṣam — the jambu tree; jigāya — conquered; saḥ — He.
notes: The cosmic Jambu tree on Meru yields the juice from which jāmbūnada gold is born; the golden Gaura beneath the tree surpassed it.

verses_en.text: Meanwhile the crest-jewel of the circle of kings, possessed of great splendour, made a royal progress there in order to see the feet of Gaurachandra.
verses_en.orig:
अत्रान्तरे गुरुश्रीको भूपचक्रशिरोमणिः ।
विजयं गौरचन्द्राङ्घ्रिदृष्टये तत्र चकार सः ॥८१॥
verses_en.translit:
atrāntare guru-śrīko bhūpa-cakra-śiromaṇiḥ |
vijayaṁ gauracandrāṅghri-dṛṣṭaye tatra cakāra saḥ ||81||
verses_en.wbw: atra antare — meanwhile; guru — of great; śrīkaḥ — [possessed] of splendour; bhūpa — of kings; cakra — of the circle; śiraḥ-maṇiḥ — the crest-jewel; vijayam — a royal progress; gauracandra — of Gaurachandra; aṅghri — the feet; dṛṣṭaye — in order to see; tatra — there; cakāra — made; saḥ — he.
notes: The king is Prataparudra. Metre: the fourth pada has nine syllables instead of eight (dṛṣṭaye tatra cakāra saḥ: —⏑——⏑⏑—⏑—); the text is not emended.

verses_en.text: With Ramananda as his companion — like Smara with Spring — accompanied by forces of four divisions, he then arrived at the proper time.
verses_en.orig:
रामानन्दसहायः स सवसन्त इव स्मरः ।
चतुरङ्गबलैर्युक्तः समयात् समयात्ततः ॥८२॥
verses_en.translit:
rāmānanda-sahāyaḥ sa savasanta iva smaraḥ |
catur-aṅga-balair yuktaḥ samayāt samayāt tataḥ ||82||
verses_en.wbw: rāmānanda — Ramananda; sahāyaḥ — [having as his] companion; saḥ — he; sa-vasantaḥ — with Spring; iva — like; smaraḥ — Smara (Kama); catuḥ-aṅga — of four divisions; balaiḥ — with forces; yuktaḥ — accompanied; samayāt — at the proper time; samayāt — arrived; tataḥ — then.
notes: Yamaka: samayāt samayāt — first the ablative of samaya, "at the [proper] time", then the imperfect sam-ayāt, "arrived". The four divisions of an army are elephants, horses, chariots and infantry.

verses_en.text: Descending from the back of his elephant, the most handsome [king], whose shoulders were like an elephant's, joyfully went on foot towards that garden and shone greatly.
verses_en.orig:
अवतीर्य गजस्कन्धात् गजस्कन्धातिसुन्दरः ।
तदारामं प्रति प्रीत्या भूमौ गच्छन् बभौ भृशम् ॥८३॥
verses_en.translit:
avatīrya gaja-skandhāt gaja-skandhāti-sundaraḥ |
tad-ārāmaṁ prati prītyā bhūmau gacchan babhau bhṛśam ||83||
verses_en.wbw: avatīrya — having descended; gaja — of the elephant; skandhāt — from the back; gaja — [like] an elephant's; skandha — [whose] shoulders [were]; ati-sundaraḥ — most handsome; tat — to that; ārāmam prati — towards the garden; prītyā — joyfully; bhūmau — on the ground (on foot); gacchan — going; babhau — shone; bhṛśam — greatly.
notes: Yamaka: gaja-skandhāt (from the elephant's back) / gaja-skandhāti-sundaraḥ (most handsome, with shoulders like an elephant's).

verses_en.text: Surrounded by huge elephants, ever flowing with ichor, [like mountains yet] not immobile, by horses and by the moving wealth of infantry, he shone more and more.
verses_en.orig:
सदा सदानैर्गुरुभिर्नागैर्नागैर्हयैर्वृतः ।
पत्तिसंपत्तिसञ्चार्यैर्भूयो भूयो रराज सः ॥८४॥
verses_en.translit:
sadā sadānair gurubhir nāgair nāgair hayair vṛtaḥ |
patti-saṁpatti-sañcāryair bhūyo bhūyo rarāja saḥ ||84||
verses_en.wbw: sadā — always; sa-dānaiḥ — with ichor [flowing]; gurubhiḥ — huge; nāgaiḥ — by elephants; nāgaiḥ (= na-agaiḥ) — moving (lit. "not immobile"); hayaiḥ — by horses; vṛtaḥ — surrounded; patti — of infantry; saṁpatti — by the wealth; sañcāryaiḥ — moving; bhūyaḥ bhūyaḥ — more and more; rarāja — shone; saḥ — he.
notes: Yamaka: sadā sadānaiḥ, nāgair nāgair, patti-saṁpatti-, bhūyo bhūyo. In nāgair nāgair the first word means "elephants"; the second is divided na-agaiḥ, "not immobile" (aga, "that which does not move", is a mountain or a tree) ⟨?⟩. Dāna is the ichor that flows from an elephant's temples in rut.

verses_en.text: As if loudly proclaiming here and there, "There is no king equal to him, either in heaven or on earth!", the horses churned [the ground] with their hooves.
verses_en.orig:
नास्त्येवास्य समो राजा किं स्वर्गे किं महीतले ।
इतीव तत्र तत्रोच्चैः क्षुरैरक्षोभि घोटकैः ॥८५॥
verses_en.translit:
nāsty evāsya samo rājā kiṁ svarge kiṁ mahī-tale |
itīva tatra tatroccaiḥ kṣurair akṣobhi ghoṭakaiḥ ||85||
verses_en.wbw: na asti eva — there is not at all; asya — to him; samaḥ — equal; rājā — a king; kim svarge — whether in heaven; kim mahī-tale — or on the surface of the earth; iti iva — as if [proclaiming] thus; tatra tatra — here and there; uccaiḥ — loudly (or: tall, with ghoṭakaiḥ); kṣuraiḥ — with hooves; akṣobhi — [the ground] was churned; ghoṭakaiḥ — by the horses.
notes: Uccaiḥ may be the adverb "loudly" (with the implied proclamation) or the instrumental plural of ucca, "tall", agreeing with ghoṭakaiḥ: "the tall horses".

verses_en.text: Taking Ramananda by the arm and stationing the host of ministers all around, the king approached, like the full moon joined with the sun.
verses_en.orig:
रामानन्दभुजं धृत्वा नियोज्यामात्यसञ्चयम् ।
अभितोऽभिययौ राजा पूर्णचन्द्रोऽर्कयुग्यथा ॥८६॥
verses_en.translit:
rāmānanda-bhujaṁ dhṛtvā niyojyāmātya-sañcayam |
abhito 'bhiyayau rājā pūrṇa-candro 'rka-yug yathā ||86||
verses_en.wbw: rāmānanda — of Ramananda; bhujam — the arm; dhṛtvā — having taken; niyojya — having stationed; amātya — of ministers; sañcayam — the host; abhitaḥ — all around; abhiyayau — approached; rājā — the king; pūrṇa-candraḥ — the full moon; arka — with the sun; yuk — joined; yathā — like.

verses_en.text: First [came] that tract of ground, encircled by the ministers, who were like the immortals, stationed within the army; it shone.
verses_en.orig:
अमात्यैरमरप्रायैरन्तर्बलनिवेशिभिः ।
प्रथमं वलयीभूतो भूप्रदेशो रराज सः ॥८७॥
verses_en.translit:
amātyair amara-prāyair antar-bala-niveśibhiḥ |
prathamaṁ valayībhūto bhū-pradeśo rarāja saḥ ||87||
verses_en.wbw: amātyaiḥ — by the ministers; amara — the immortals; prāyaiḥ — resembling; antaḥ — within; bala — the army; niveśibhiḥ — stationed; prathamam — first; valayībhūtaḥ — encircled; bhū-pradeśaḥ — tract of ground; rarāja — shone; saḥ — that.
notes: The edition gives the variant antar-vana-nivāsibhiḥ ("dwelling in the forest") and rejects it: "this reading is not good".

verses_en.text: Outside that stood the foot-soldiers; outside them a host of horses; and outside them all the elephants: a veritable battle array was formed then.
verses_en.orig:
तद्बहिः पत्तयोऽतिष्ठंस्तद्बहिर्हयसञ्चयः ।
तद्बहिश्च गजाः सर्वे व्यूह एवाभवत्तदा ॥८८॥
verses_en.translit:
tad-bahiḥ pattayo 'tiṣṭhaṁs tad-bahir haya-sañcayaḥ |
tad-bahiś ca gajāḥ sarve vyūha evābhavat tadā ||88||
verses_en.wbw: tat-bahiḥ — outside that; pattayaḥ — the foot-soldiers; atiṣṭhan — stood; tat-bahiḥ — outside that; haya — of horses; sañcayaḥ — a host; tat-bahiḥ ca — and outside that; gajāḥ — the elephants; sarve — all; vyūhaḥ eva — a veritable battle array; abhavat — was formed; tadā — then.
notes: Cf. the three rings around the dancing Lord in 16.24.

verses_en.text: Seeing the pair of lotus feet there, the king, his heart melting, fell to the ground again and again together with tears of joy.
verses_en.orig:
पादारविन्दयुगलं वीक्ष्य तत्र द्रवन्मनाः ।
भूपतिर्भूतलं भूयः प्राप हर्षाश्रुणा सह ॥८९॥
(असन्ध्यक्षरः)
verses_en.translit:
pādāravinda-yugalaṁ vīkṣya tatra dravan-manāḥ |
bhūpatir bhū-talaṁ bhūyaḥ prāpa harṣāśruṇā saha ||89||
(asandhy-akṣaraḥ)
verses_en.wbw: pāda — of feet; aravinda — lotus; yugalam — the pair; vīkṣya — having seen; tatra — there; dravat — melting; manāḥ — [whose] heart [was]; bhū-patiḥ — the king; bhū-talam — the surface of the earth; bhūyaḥ — again and again; prāpa — reached (fell to); harṣa — of joy; aśruṇā — tears; saha — together with.
notes: Asandhy-akṣara: a verse without diphthongs (e, ai, o, au), as the edition's subscript indicates; note also the alliteration bhūpatir bhū-talaṁ bhūyaḥ. Cf. the Chaitanya-charitamrita, Madhya 16.102–107: while the Lord rests beneath the bakula tree, Ramananda brings the king, who falls at His feet and offers prayers.

verses_en.text: Having bowed down many times, the king drank with his eyes the lotus of [the Lord's] face and could not be sated. Wonderful are the doings of Gauranga!
verses_en.orig:
प्रणम्य बहुधा दृग्भ्यामपिबद्वदनाम्बुजम् ।
न च तृप्तिमगाद्भूपश्चित्रं गौराङ्गचेष्टितम् ॥९०॥
verses_en.translit:
praṇamya bahudhā dṛgbhyām apibad vadanāmbujam |
na ca tṛptim agād bhūpaś citraṁ gaurāṅga-ceṣṭitam ||90||
verses_en.wbw: praṇamya — having bowed down; bahudhā — many times; dṛgbhyām — with [his] two eyes; apibat — drank; vadana — of the face; ambujam — the lotus; na ca — and not; tṛptim — satiety; agāt — attained; bhūpaḥ — the king; citram — wonderful; gaurāṅga — of Gauranga; ceṣṭitam — the doing.
notes: The edition notes the variant na tṛptim agamad bhūpaḥ.

verses_en.text: Gaurachandra too, speaking to him lovingly in many ways, sprinkled his whole body with the nectar of His words, as if embracing him from head to foot.
verses_en.orig:
बहुधा गौरचन्द्रोऽपि प्रेम्णाभाष्य वचोऽमृतैः ।
सिषेच तस्य सर्वाङ्गं सर्वाङ्गीनमिवाश्लिषन् ॥९१॥
verses_en.translit:
bahudhā gauracandro 'pi premṇābhāṣya vaco-'mṛtaiḥ |
siṣeca tasya sarvāṅgaṁ sarvāṅgīnam ivāśliṣan ||91||
verses_en.wbw: bahudhā — in many ways; gauracandraḥ api — Gaurachandra too; premṇā — with love; ābhāṣya — having spoken; vacaḥ — of words; amṛtaiḥ — with the nectar; siṣeca — sprinkled; tasya — his; sarva-aṅgam — whole body; sarva-aṅgīnam — [with an embrace] covering the whole body; iva — as if; āśliṣan — embracing.

verses_en.text: Having received [the Lord's] command and favour, his purpose accomplished, he departed; then all the throngs of ministers quickly went to see [the Lord].
verses_en.orig:
आज्ञायाज्ञां प्रसादं च कृतकृत्यः स निर्ययौ ।
अमात्यनिचयाः सर्वे ततो द्रष्टुं ययुर्द्रुतम् ॥९२॥
verses_en.translit:
ājñāyājñāṁ prasādaṁ ca kṛta-kṛtyaḥ sa niryayau |
amātya-nicayāḥ sarve tato draṣṭuṁ yayur drutam ||92||
verses_en.wbw: ājñāya — having received; ājñām — the command; prasādam — the favour; ca — and; kṛta-kṛtyaḥ — having accomplished [his] purpose; saḥ — he; niryayau — departed; amātya — of ministers; nicayāḥ — the throngs; sarve — all; tataḥ — then; draṣṭum — to see [the Lord]; yayuḥ — went; drutam — quickly.
notes: A play on sounds: ājñāyājñām.

verses_en.text: Having learnt the intention of [the Lord], who wished to go beyond the Chitrotpala — as [one would go] into the ocean for many-coloured lotuses ⟨?⟩ — he, the king, said to a worthy [servant]:
verses_en.orig:
पारेचित्रोत्पलं सोऽकूपारे चित्रोत्पलं यथा ।
यियासोः स्वमतं ज्ञात्वा भूपः सत्पात्रमब्रवीत् ॥९३॥
(पद्मभेदः)
verses_en.translit:
pāre-citrotpalaṁ so 'kūpāre citrotpalaṁ yathā |
yiyāsoḥ svamataṁ jñātvā bhūpaḥ sat-pātram abravīt ||93||
(padma-bhedaḥ)
verses_en.wbw: pāre-citrotpalam — beyond the Chitrotpala; saḥ — he; akūpāre — in the ocean; citra-utpalam yathā — as [one would go] for many-coloured lotuses; yiyāsoḥ — of [the Lord], who wished to go; svamatam — the intention; jñātvā — having learnt; bhūpaḥ — the king; sat-pātram — to a worthy person; abravīt — said.
notes: Padma-bandha (the edition's subscript: padma-bhedaḥ), "the lotus pattern": a figured verse whose syllables, written out in a diagram, form the shape of a lotus (the arrangement itself is not explained ⟨?⟩). The first line also contains the near-repetition pāre-citrotpalam / akūpāre citrotpalam (yamaka). The Chitrotpala is a river (a branch of the Mahanadi; cf. 94). The edition's Sanskrit commentary: pāre-citrotpalam is an avyayībhāva compound under the rule "pāre and madhye [are compounded] with a genitive"; akūpāra means "ocean" (according to the Amarakosha). The point of the simile is not clear ⟨?⟩.

verses_en.text: "O Mangaraja, you yourself, together with Harichandana, should quickly escort Mahaprabhu beyond the Mahanadi."
verses_en.orig:
मङ्गराज भवानेव हरिचन्दनसंगतः ।
पारेमहानदि महाप्रभुमन्वेतु सत्वरम् ॥९४॥
verses_en.translit:
maṅgarāja bhavān eva haricandana-saṁgataḥ |
pāre-mahānadi mahāprabhum anvetu satvaram ||94||
verses_en.wbw: maṅgarāja — O Mangaraja; bhavān — your honour; eva — indeed; haricandana — Harichandana; saṁgataḥ — together with; pāre-mahānadi — beyond the Mahanadi; mahāprabhum — Mahaprabhu; anvetu — should escort; satvaram — quickly.
notes: The edition has bhavānena; the Gosvami edition (GGM) reads bhavān eva, and this reading is adopted. Mangaraja and Harichandana are officers of the king; cf. the Chaitanya-charitamrita, Madhya 16.113, 126: the king entrusts Harichandana and Mangaraja with the service of the Lord, and they follow Him together with Ramananda.

verses_en.text: By his command they — and Sri Ramananda Raya too — made ready very large boats and then brought the Lord across.
verses_en.orig:
तदाज्ञयाथ ते सोऽपि श्रीरामानन्दरायकः ।
नौकाः सुमहतीश्चक्रे प्रभुं चाथ समानयन् ॥९५॥
verses_en.translit:
tad-ājñayātha te so 'pi śrī-rāmānanda-rāyakaḥ |
naukāḥ sumahatīś cakre prabhuṁ cātha samānayan ||95||
verses_en.wbw: tat-ājñayā — by his command; atha — then; te — they; saḥ api — he too; śrī-rāmānanda-rāyakaḥ — Sri Ramananda Raya; naukāḥ — boats; su-mahatīḥ — very large; cakre — prepared; prabhum — the Lord; ca — and; atha — then; samānayan — brought across.
notes: Cakre, "prepared", is singular (with Ramananda), while samānayan, "brought", is plural.

verses_en.text: Then the divine full moon, marked with a deer, rose, and with his rays — his hands — swept the whole road clean.
verses_en.orig:
उदियाय तदा पूर्णो भगवान् मृगलाञ्छनः ।
करैः सम्मार्जयामास पन्थानमखिलं ततः ॥९६॥
verses_en.translit:
udiyāya tadā pūrṇo bhagavān mṛga-lāñchanaḥ |
karaiḥ sammārjayāmāsa panthānam akhilaṁ tataḥ ||96||
verses_en.wbw: udiyāya — rose; tadā — then; pūrṇaḥ — full; bhagavān — the divine; mṛga — with a deer; lāñchanaḥ — marked (the moon); karaiḥ — with [his] rays (= hands); sammārjayāmāsa — swept clean; panthānam — the road; akhilam — the whole; tataḥ — then.

karnapura-ckm.title: Путь через Ориссу; Рамананда возвращается от Бхадры
karnapura-ckm.summary: Господь отпускает царских министров; по письменным приказам царя для Него повсюду заранее строят жилища, толпы встречают Его кликами «Идёт!»; когда спрашивают, где Кришна-Чайтанья, Он и Парамананда Пури в шутку указывают друг на друга; у Бхадры Господь отпускает Рамананду, и тот в разлуке возвращается в Кшетру.

verses.text: Услышав щебет птиц: «Ночь прошла, Владыка, покинь ложе!», — Он быстро потёр рукой запечатанные сном глаза, [говоря им]: «Проснитесь!» — и поднялся.
verses.orig:
रात्रिर्याता नाथ तल्पं जहीही-
त्याकर्ण्य पक्षिणां कूजितानि ।
नेत्रे निद्रामुद्रिते जागृहीति
द्रागाक्षिप्यन् पाणिनाथोदियाय ॥१॥
verses.translit:
rātrir yātā nātha talpaṁ jahīhīty
ākarṇya pakṣiṇāṁ kūjitāni |
netre nidrā-mudrite jāgṛhīti
drāg ākṣipyan pāṇinā thodiyāya (pāṇinātha udiyāya) ||1||
verses.wbw: rātriḥ — ночь; yātā — прошла; nātha — о Владыка; talpam — ложе; jahīhi — покинь; iti — так; ākarṇya — услышав; pakṣiṇām — птиц; kūjitāni — щебет; netre — глаза; nidrā — сном; mudrite — запечатанные; jāgṛhi — проснитесь; iti — [говоря] так; drāk — быстро; ākṣipyan — потирая; pāṇinā — рукой; atha — затем; udiyāya — поднялся.
notes: Размер — шалини (так в издании: «до ст. 36 — шалини»).

verses.text: Увидев освящённую пищу, только что туда прибывшую, Он радостно начал ежедневные обряды; вволю вкусив со всеми рис, питьё, пирожки и прочее, довольный, Он отправился в путь.
verses.orig:
निर्माल्यान्नं तत्र सद्यः समेतं
दृष्ट्वा हर्षादाह्निकान्यारभेत ।
अन्नं पानं पिष्टकादि प्रकामं
